units.rightText: You did not go up to the gaps or restore the wall around the house of Israel so that it would stand in the battle on the Day of the LORD.

units.leftText: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘The LORD says;’ but the LORD has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.
units.rightText: They see false visions and speak lying divinations. They claim, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ when the LORD did not send them; yet they wait for the fulfillment of their message.

units.leftText: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘The LORD says;’ but I have not spoken?”
units.rightText: Haven’t you seen a false vision and spoken a lying divination when you proclaim, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ even though I have not spoken?

units.leftText: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have uttered vain words and seen false visions, I am against you, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and speak lying divinations. They will not belong to the council of My people or be recorded in the register of the house of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.
units.rightText: Because they have led My people astray, saying, ‘Peace,’ when there is no peace, and whitewashing any flimsy wall that is built,

units.leftText: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.
units.rightText: tell those whitewashing the wall that it will fall. Rain will come in torrents, I will send hailstones plunging down, and a windstorm will burst forth.

units.leftText: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”
units.rightText: Surely when the wall has fallen, you will not be asked, ‘Where is the whitewash with which you covered it?’

units.leftText: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: In My wrath I will release a windstorm, and in My anger torrents of rain and hail will fall with destructive fury.

units.leftText: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: I will tear down the wall you whitewashed and level it to the ground, so that its foundation is exposed. The city will fall, and you will be destroyed within it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

units.leftText: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—
units.rightText: And after I have vented My wrath against the wall and against those who whitewashed it, I will say to you: ‘The wall is gone, and so are those who whitewashed it —

units.leftText: to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace,’” says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw a vision of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Lord GOD.’

units.leftText: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,
units.rightText: Now, O son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own imagination. Prophesy against them

units.leftText: and say, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?
units.rightText: and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the women who sew magic charms on their wrists and make veils for the heads of people of every height, in order to ensnare their souls. Will you ensnare the souls of My people but preserve your own?

units.leftText: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’
units.rightText: You have profaned Me among My people for handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to My people who would listen, you have killed those who should not have died and spared those who should not have lived.

units.leftText: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: See, I am against the magic charms with which you ensnare souls like birds, and I will tear them from your arms. So I will free the souls you have ensnared like birds.

units.leftText: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: I will also tear off your veils and deliver My people from your hands, so that they will no longer be prey in your hands. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

units.leftText: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.
units.rightText: Because you have disheartened the righteous with your lies, even though I have caused them no grief, and because you have encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways to save their lives,

units.leftText: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”
units.rightText: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will deliver My people from your hands. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”

units.leftText: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
units.rightText: Then some of the elders of Israel came and sat down before me.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?
units.rightText: “Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and put wicked stumbling blocks before their faces. Should I consult with them in any way?

units.leftText: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,
units.rightText: Therefore speak to them and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When any Israelite sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face, and then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him according to his great idolatry,

units.leftText: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’
units.rightText: so that I may take hold of the hearts of the people of Israel. For because of their idols, they are all estranged from Me.’

units.leftText: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.
units.rightText: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Repent and turn away from your idols; turn your faces away from all your abominations.

units.leftText: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I the LORD will answer him by myself.
units.rightText: For when any Israelite or any foreigner dwelling in Israel separates himself from Me, sets up idols in his heart, and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face, and then comes to the prophet to inquire of Me, I the LORD will answer him Myself.

units.leftText: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: I will set My face against that man and make him a sign and a proverb; I will cut him off from among My people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

units.leftText: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, the LORD, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.
units.rightText: But if the prophet is enticed to speak a message, then it was I the LORD who enticed him, and I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from among My people Israel.

units.leftText: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,
units.rightText: They will bear their punishment— the punishment of the inquirer will be the same as that of the prophet—

units.leftText: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: in order that the house of Israel may no longer stray from Me and no longer defile themselves with all their transgressions. Then they will be My people and I will be their God, declares the Lord GOD.’”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—
units.rightText: “Son of man, if a land sins against Me by acting unfaithfully, and I stretch out My hand against it to cut off its supply of food, to send famine upon it, and to cut off from it both man and beast,
rightNotes: 14:13 Hebrew staff

units.leftText: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: then even if these three men— Noah, Daniel, and Job— were in it, their righteousness could deliver only themselves, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—
units.rightText: Or if I send wild beasts through the land to leave it childless and desolate, with no man passing through it for fear of the beasts,

units.leftText: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.
units.rightText: then as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if these three men were in it, they could not deliver their own sons or daughters. They alone would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.

units.leftText: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—
units.rightText: Or if I bring a sword against that land and say, ‘Let a sword pass through it,’ so that I cut off from it both man and beast,

units.leftText: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.
units.rightText: then as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if these three men were in it, they could not deliver their own sons or daughters. They alone would be delivered.

units.leftText: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—
units.rightText: Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out My wrath upon it through bloodshed, cutting off from it both man and beast,

units.leftText: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”
units.rightText: then as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, they could not deliver their own sons or daughters. Their righteousness could deliver only themselves.

units.leftText: For the Lord GOD says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!
units.rightText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘How much worse will it be when I send against Jerusalem My four dire judgments— sword, famine, wild beasts, and plague— in order to cut off from it both man and beast?

units.leftText: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.
units.rightText: Yet , behold, some survivors will be left in it — sons and daughters who will be brought out. They will come out to you, and when you see their conduct and actions, you will be comforted regarding the disaster I have brought upon Jerusalem — all that I have brought upon it.

units.leftText: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: They will bring you consolation when you see their conduct and actions, and you will know that it was not without cause that I have done all these things within it,’ declares the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?
units.rightText: “Son of man, how does the wood of the vine surpass any other branch among the trees in the forest?

units.leftText: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?
units.rightText: Can wood be taken from it to make something useful? Or can one make from it a peg on which to hang utensils?

units.leftText: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?
units.rightText: No, it is cast into the fire for fuel. The fire devours both ends, and the middle is charred. Can it be useful for anything?

units.leftText: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”
units.rightText: Even when it was whole, it could not be made useful. How much less can it ever be useful when the fire has consumed it and charred it!

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give up the people of Jerusalem.

units.leftText: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.
units.rightText: And I will set My face against them. Though they may have escaped the fire, yet another fire will consume them. And when I set My face against them, you will know that I am the LORD.

units.leftText: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Thus I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,’ declares the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: Again the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;
units.rightText: “Son of man, confront Jerusalem with her abominations

units.leftText: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.
units.rightText: and tell her that this is what the Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: Your origin and your birth were in the land of the Canaanites. Your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.

units.leftText: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.
units.rightText: On the day of your birth your cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water for cleansing. You were not rubbed with salt or wrapped in cloths.

units.leftText: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.
units.rightText: No one cared enough for you to do even one of these things out of compassion for you. Instead, you were thrown out into the open field, because you were despised on the day of your birth.

units.leftText: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’
units.rightText: Then I passed by and saw you wallowing in your blood, and as you lay there in your blood I said to you, ‘Live!’ There I said to you, ‘Live!’

units.leftText: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.
units.rightText: I made you thrive like a plant of the field. You grew up and matured and became very beautiful. Your breasts were formed and your hair grew, but you were naked and bare.

units.leftText: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord GOD, “and you became mine.
units.rightText: Then I passed by and saw you, and you were indeed old enough for love. So I spread My cloak over you and covered your nakedness. I pledged Myself to you, entered into a covenant with you, and you became Mine, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.
units.rightText: Then I bathed you with water, rinsed off your blood, and anointed you with oil.

units.leftText: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.
units.rightText: I clothed you in embroidered cloth and gave you sandals of fine leather. I wrapped you in fine linen and covered you with silk.

units.leftText: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.
units.rightText: I adorned you with jewelry, and I put bracelets on your wrists and a chain around your neck.

units.leftText: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.
units.rightText: I put a ring in your nose, earrings on your ears, and a beautiful crown upon your head.

units.leftText: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.
units.rightText: So you were adorned with gold and silver, and your clothing was made of fine linen, silk, and embroidered cloth. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You became very beautiful and rose to be queen.

units.leftText: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty, for it was perfect in the splendor I bestowed on you, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.
units.rightText: But because of your fame, you trusted in your beauty and played the harlot. You lavished your favors on everyone who passed by, and your beauty was theirs for the asking.

units.leftText: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.
units.rightText: You took some of your garments and made colorful high places for yourself, and on them you prostituted yourself. Such things should not have happened; never should they have occurred!

units.leftText: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.
units.rightText: You also took the fine jewelry of gold and silver I had given you, and you made male idols with which to prostitute yourself.

units.leftText: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.
units.rightText: You took your embroidered garments to cover them, and you set My oil and incense before them.

units.leftText: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: And you set before them as a pleasing aroma the food I had given you— the fine flour, oil, and honey that I had fed you. That is what happened, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,
units.rightText: You even took the sons and daughters you bore to Me and sacrificed them as food to idols. Was your prostitution not enough?

units.leftText: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?
units.rightText: You slaughtered My children and delivered them up through the fire to idols.

units.leftText: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.
units.rightText: And in all your abominations and acts of prostitution, you did not remember the days of your youth when you were naked and bare, wallowing in your own blood.

units.leftText: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord GOD—
units.rightText: Woe! Woe to you, declares the Lord GOD. And in addition to all your other wickedness,

units.leftText: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.
units.rightText: you built yourself a mound and made yourself a lofty shrine in every public square.

units.leftText: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.
units.rightText: At the head of every street you built your lofty shrines and degraded your beauty. With increasing promiscuity, you spread your legs to all who passed by.

units.leftText: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.
units.rightText: You prostituted yourself with your lustful neighbors, the Egyptians, and increased your promiscuity to provoke Me to anger.

units.leftText: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.
units.rightText: Therefore I stretched out My hand against you and reduced your portion. I gave you over to the desire of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your lewd conduct.

units.leftText: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.
units.rightText: Then you prostituted yourself with the Assyrians, because you were not yet satisfied. Even after that, you were still not satisfied.

units.leftText: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.
units.rightText: So you extended your promiscuity to Chaldea, the land of merchants — but even with this you were not satisfied!
rightNotes: 16:29 Or Babylonia

units.leftText: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord GOD, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;
units.rightText: How weak-willed is your heart, declares the Lord GOD, while you do all these things, the acts of a shameless prostitute!
rightNotes: 16:30 Or How feverish is your heart,

units.leftText: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.
units.rightText: But when you built your mounds at the head of every street and made your lofty shrines in every public square, you were not even like a prostitute, because you scorned payment.

units.leftText: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!
units.rightText: You adulterous wife! You receive strangers instead of your own husband!

units.leftText: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.
units.rightText: Men give gifts to all their prostitutes, but you gave gifts to all your lovers. You bribed them to come to you from everywhere for your illicit favors.

units.leftText: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’
units.rightText: So your prostitution is the opposite of that of other women: No one solicited your favors, and you paid a fee instead of receiving one; so you are the very opposite!

units.leftText: “Therefore, prostitute, hear the LORD’s word:
units.rightText: Therefore, O prostitute, hear the word of the LORD!

units.leftText: ‘The Lord GOD says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because you poured out your wealth and exposed your nakedness in your promiscuity with your lovers and with all your detestable idols, and because of the blood of your children which you gave to them,

units.leftText: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.
units.rightText: therefore I will surely gather all the lovers with whom you found pleasure, all those you loved and all those you hated. I will gather them against you from all around and expose you before them, and they will see you completely naked.

units.leftText: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
units.rightText: And I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and those who shed blood; so I will bring upon you the wrath of your bloodshed and jealousy.

units.leftText: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.
units.rightText: Then I will deliver you into the hands of your lovers, and they will level your mounds and tear down your lofty shrines. They will strip off your clothes, take your fine jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.

units.leftText: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.
units.rightText: They will bring a mob against you, who will stone you and cut you to pieces with their swords.

units.leftText: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.
units.rightText: Then they will burn down your houses and execute judgment against you in the sight of many women.

units.leftText: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.
units.rightText: So I will lay to rest My wrath against you, and My jealousy will turn away from you. Then I will be calm and no longer angry.

units.leftText: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord GOD: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.
units.rightText: Because you did not remember the days of your youth, but enraged Me with all these things, I will surely bring your deeds down upon your own head, declares the Lord GOD. Have you not committed this lewdness on top of all your other abominations?

units.leftText: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’
units.rightText: Behold, all who speak in proverbs will quote this proverb about you:

units.leftText: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
units.rightText: You are the daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and children. You are the sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.

units.leftText: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.
units.rightText: Your older sister was Samaria, who lived with her daughters to your north; and your younger sister was Sodom, who lived with her daughters to your south.

units.leftText: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.
units.rightText: And you not only walked in their ways and practiced their abominations, but soon you were more depraved than they were.

units.leftText: As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
units.rightText: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, your sister Sodom and her daughters never did as you and your daughters have done.

units.leftText: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
units.rightText: Now this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were arrogant, overfed, and complacent; they did not help the poor and needy.

units.leftText: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.
units.rightText: Thus they were haughty and committed abominations before Me. Therefore I removed them, as you have seen.
rightNotes: 16:50 A few Hebrew manuscripts and LXX; MT as I have seen

units.leftText: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.
units.rightText: Furthermore, Samaria did not commit half the sins you did. You have multiplied your abominations beyond theirs, and all the abominations you have committed have made your sisters appear righteous.

units.leftText: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.
units.rightText: So now you must bear your disgrace, since you have brought justification for your sisters. For they appear more righteous than you, because your sins were more vile than theirs. So you too must bear your shame and disgrace, since you have made your sisters appear righteous.

units.leftText: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;
units.rightText: But I will restore Sodom and her daughters from captivity, as well as Samaria and her daughters. And I will restore you along with them.
rightNotes: 16:53 Or restore the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters

units.leftText: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.
units.rightText: So you will bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all you did to comfort them.

units.leftText: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.
units.rightText: And your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to their former state. You and your daughters will also return to your former state.

units.leftText: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,
units.rightText: Did you not treat your sister Sodom as an object of scorn in the day of your pride,

units.leftText: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.
units.rightText: before your wickedness was uncovered? Even so, you are now scorned by the daughters of Edom and all those around her, and by the daughters of the Philistines— all those around you who despise you.
rightNotes: 16:57 Many Hebrew manuscripts and Syriac; most Hebrew manuscripts, LXX, and Vulgate Aram

units.leftText: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your abominations, declares the LORD.

units.leftText: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
units.rightText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: I will deal with you according to your deeds, since you have despised the oath by breaking the covenant.

units.leftText: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
units.rightText: But I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

units.leftText: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.
units.rightText: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your older and younger sisters. I will give them to you as daughters, but not because of My covenant with you.

units.leftText: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am the LORD;
units.rightText: So I will establish My covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD,

units.leftText: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: so that when I make atonement for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed and never again open your mouth because of your disgrace, declares the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;
units.rightText: “Son of man, pose a riddle; speak a parable to the house of Israel

units.leftText: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.
units.rightText: and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.
units.rightText: He plucked off its topmost shoot,

units.leftText: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.
units.rightText: He took some of the seed of the land

units.leftText: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.
units.rightText: It sprouted and became a spreading vine,

units.leftText: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.
units.rightText: But there was another great eagle

units.leftText: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’
units.rightText: It had been planted in good soil

units.leftText: “Say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.
units.rightText: So you are to tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”
units.rightText: Even if it is transplanted,

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.
units.rightText: “Now say to this rebellious house: ‘Do you not know what these things mean?’

units.leftText: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,
units.rightText: He took a member of the royal family and made a covenant with him, putting him under oath. Then he carried away the leading men of the land,
leftNotes: 17:13 or, seed
rightNotes: 17:13 Hebrew the royal seed

units.leftText: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.
units.rightText: so that the kingdom would be brought low, unable to lift itself up, surviving only by keeping his covenant.

units.leftText: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?
units.rightText: But this king rebelled against Babylon by sending his envoys to Egypt to ask for horses and a large army. Will he flourish? Will the one who does such things escape? Can he break a covenant and yet escape?’

units.leftText: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord GOD, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.
units.rightText: ‘As surely as I live,’ declares the Lord GOD, ‘he will die in Babylon, in the land of the king who enthroned him, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke.

units.leftText: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.
units.rightText: Pharaoh with his mighty army and vast horde will not help him in battle, when ramps are built and siege walls constructed to destroy many lives.

units.leftText: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.
units.rightText: He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Seeing that he gave his hand in pledge yet did all these things, he will not escape!’

units.leftText: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘As surely as I live, I will bring down upon his head My oath that he despised and My covenant that he broke.

units.leftText: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.
units.rightText: I will spread My net over him and catch him in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon and execute judgment upon him there for the treason he committed against Me.

units.leftText: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it.’
units.rightText: All his choice troops will fall by the sword, and those who survive will be scattered to every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken.’
rightNotes: 17:21 Many Hebrew manuscripts; MT All his fleeing troops

units.leftText: “The Lord GOD says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.
units.rightText: I will plant it on the mountain heights of Israel

units.leftText: All the trees of the field will know that I, the LORD, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish.
units.rightText: Then all the trees of the field will know

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me again, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying,
units.rightText: “What do you people mean by quoting this proverb about the land of Israel:

units.leftText: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.
units.rightText: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.

units.leftText: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.
units.rightText: Behold, every soul belongs to Me; both father and son are Mine. The soul who sins is the one who will die.

units.leftText: “But if a man is just,
units.rightText: Now suppose a man is righteous and does what is just and right:

units.leftText: and has not eaten on the mountains,
units.rightText: He does not eat at the mountain

units.leftText: and has not wronged any,
units.rightText: He does not oppress another,

units.leftText: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest,
units.rightText: He does not engage in usury

units.leftText: has walked in my statutes,
units.rightText: He follows My statutes

units.leftText: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,
units.rightText: Now suppose that man has a violent son, who sheds blood or does any of these things,

units.leftText: or who does not do any of those things
units.rightText: though the father has done none of them:

units.leftText: has wronged the poor and needy,
units.rightText: He oppresses the poor and needy;

units.leftText: has lent with interest,
units.rightText: He engages in usury

units.leftText: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise,
units.rightText: Now suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father has committed, considers them, and does not do likewise:

units.leftText: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains,
units.rightText: He does not eat at the mountain

units.leftText: hasn’t wronged any,
units.rightText: He does not oppress another,

units.leftText: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor,
units.rightText: He withholds his hand from harming the poor
rightNotes: 18:17 Hebrew; LXX He withholds his hand from iniquity

units.leftText: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.
units.rightText: As for his father, he will die for his own iniquity, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what was wrong among his people.

units.leftText: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.
units.rightText: Yet you may ask, ‘Why shouldn’t the son bear the iniquity of his father?’

units.leftText: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.
units.rightText: The soul who sins is the one who will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of his father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of his son. The righteousness of the righteous man will fall upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked man will fall upon him.

units.leftText: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
units.rightText: But if the wicked man turns from all the sins he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is just and right, he will surely live; he will not die.

units.leftText: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.
units.rightText: None of the transgressions he has committed will be held against him. Because of the righteousness he has practiced, he will live.

units.leftText: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord GOD, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?
units.rightText: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Lord GOD. Wouldn’t I prefer that he turn from his ways and live?

units.leftText: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.
units.rightText: But if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity, committing the same abominations as the wicked, will he live? None of the righteous acts he did will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness and sin he has committed, he will die.

units.leftText: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?
units.rightText: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’

units.leftText: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.
units.rightText: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity, he will die for this. He will die because of the iniquity he has committed.

units.leftText: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.
units.rightText: But if a wicked man turns from the wickedness he has committed and does what is just and right, he will save his life.

units.leftText: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.
units.rightText: Because he considered and turned from all the transgressions he had committed, he will surely live; he will not die.

units.leftText: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?
units.rightText: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’

units.leftText: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord GOD. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.
units.rightText: Therefore, O house of Israel, I will judge you, each according to his ways, declares the Lord GOD. Repent and turn from all your transgressions, so that your iniquity will not become your downfall.

units.leftText: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?
units.rightText: Cast away from yourselves all the transgressions you have committed, and fashion for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why should you die, O house of Israel?

units.leftText: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord GOD. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!
units.rightText: For I take no pleasure in anyone’s death, declares the Lord GOD. So repent and live![’’]

units.leftText: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
units.rightText: “As for you, take up a lament for the princes of Israel

units.leftText: and say,
units.rightText: and say:

units.rightText: She brought up one of her cubs,

units.leftText: The nations also heard of him.
units.rightText: When the nations heard of him,

units.leftText: “‘Now when she saw that she had waited,
units.rightText: When she saw that she had waited in vain,

units.leftText: He went up and down among the lions.
units.rightText: He prowled among the lions,

units.leftText: He knew their palaces,
units.rightText: He broke down their strongholds
rightNotes: 19:7 Or He knew their widows or He seized their widows

units.leftText: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces.
units.rightText: Then the nations set out against him

units.leftText: They put him in a cage with hooks,
units.rightText: With hooks they caged him

units.leftText: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters.
units.rightText: Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard,
rightNotes: 19:10 Some Hebrew manuscripts; most Hebrew manuscripts in your bloodline

units.leftText: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled.
units.rightText: It had strong branches, fit for a ruler’s scepter.

units.leftText: But it was plucked up in fury.
units.rightText: But it was uprooted in fury,

units.leftText: Now it is planted in the wilderness,
units.rightText: Now it is planted in the wilderness,

units.leftText: Fire has gone out of its branches.
units.rightText: Fire has gone out from its main branch

units.leftText: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and sat before me.
units.rightText: In the seventh year, on the tenth day of the fifth month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and they sat down before me.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will not be inquired of by you.”’
units.rightText: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: Have you come to inquire of Me? As surely as I live, I will not be consulted by you, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.
units.rightText: Will you judge them, will you judge them, son of man? Confront them with the abominations of their fathers

units.leftText: Tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, ‘I am the LORD your God;’
units.rightText: and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I chose Israel, I swore an oath to the descendants of the house of Jacob and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt. With an uplifted hand I said to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.’

units.leftText: in that day I swore to them to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.
units.rightText: On that day I swore to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands.

units.leftText: I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’
units.rightText: And I said to them: ‘Each of you must throw away the abominations before his eyes, and you must not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’

units.leftText: “‘“But they rebelled against me and wouldn’t listen to me. They didn’t all throw away the abominations of their eyes. They also didn’t forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: But they rebelled against Me and refused to listen. None of them cast away the abominations before their eyes, and they did not forsake the idols of Egypt. So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known to them in bringing them out of the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: But I acted for the sake of My name, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they were living, in whose sight I had revealed Myself to Israel by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: So I caused them to go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
units.rightText: So I brought them out of the land of Egypt and led them into the wilderness.

units.leftText: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.
units.rightText: And I gave them My statutes and made known to them My ordinances— for the man who does these things will live by them.
rightNotes: 20:11 See Leviticus 18:5|LEV 18:5*; also in Ezekiel 20:13 and 21.

units.leftText: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
units.rightText: I also gave them My Sabbaths as a sign between us, so that they would know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

units.leftText: “‘“But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They didn’t walk in my statutes and they rejected my ordinances, which if a man keeps, he shall live in them. They greatly profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness, to consume them.
units.rightText: Yet the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness. They did not follow My statutes and they rejected My ordinances— though the man who does these things will live by them — and they utterly profaned My Sabbaths. Then I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and put an end to them in the wilderness.

units.leftText: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
units.rightText: But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

units.leftText: Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands,
units.rightText: Moreover, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land that I had given them— a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands —

units.leftText: because they rejected my ordinances, and didn’t walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.
units.rightText: because they kept rejecting My ordinances, refusing to walk in My statutes, and profaning My Sabbaths; for their hearts continually went after their idols.

units.leftText: Nevertheless my eye spared them, and I didn’t destroy them. I didn’t make a full end of them in the wilderness.
units.rightText: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or bring them to an end in the wilderness.

units.leftText: I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Don’t walk in the statutes of your fathers. Don’t observe their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.
units.rightText: In the wilderness I said to their children: ‘Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers or keep their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.

units.leftText: I am the LORD your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.
units.rightText: I am the LORD your God; walk in My statutes, keep My ordinances, and practice them.

units.leftText: Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’
units.rightText: Keep My Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us, so that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’

units.leftText: “‘“But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them, which if a man does, he shall live in them. They profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
units.rightText: But the children rebelled against Me. They did not walk in My statutes or carefully observe My ordinances — though the man who does these things will live by them — and they profaned My Sabbaths. So I resolved to pour out My wrath upon them and vent My anger against them in the wilderness.

units.leftText: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
units.rightText: But I withheld My hand and acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

units.leftText: Moreover I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries,
units.rightText: However, with an uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them throughout the lands.

units.leftText: because they had not executed my ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.
units.rightText: For they did not practice My ordinances, but they rejected My statutes and profaned My Sabbaths, fixing their eyes on the idols of their fathers.

units.leftText: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances in which they couldn’t live.
units.rightText: I also gave them over to statutes that were not good and ordinances by which they could not live.

units.leftText: I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused all that opens the womb to pass through the fire, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD.”’
units.rightText: And I pronounced them unclean through their gifts — the sacrifice of every firstborn in the fire — so that I might devastate them, in order that they would know that I am the LORD.

units.leftText: “Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Moreover, in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
units.rightText: Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: In this way also your fathers blasphemed Me by their unfaithfulness against Me.

units.leftText: For when I had brought them into the land which I swore to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering. There they also made their pleasant aroma, and there they poured out their drink offerings.
units.rightText: When I brought them into the land that I swore to give them and they saw any high hill or leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, presented offerings that provoked Me, sent up their fragrant incense, and poured out their drink offerings.

units.leftText: Then I said to them, ‘What does the high place where you go mean?’ So its name is called Bamah to this day.”’
units.rightText: So I asked them: ‘What is this high place to which you go?’
leftNotes: 20:29 “Bamah” means “High Place”.

units.leftText: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Do you pollute yourselves in the way of your fathers? Do you play the prostitute after their abominations?
units.rightText: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: Will you defile yourselves the way your fathers did, prostituting yourselves with their abominations?

units.leftText: When you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, do you pollute yourselves with all your idols to this day? Should I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord GOD, I will not be inquired of by you!
units.rightText: When you offer your gifts, sacrificing your sons in the fire, you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. So should I be consulted by you, O house of Israel? As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will not be consulted by you!
rightNotes: 20:31 Literally making your sons pass through the fire

units.leftText: “‘“That which comes into your mind will not be at all, in that you say, ‘We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.’
units.rightText: When you say, ‘Let us be like the nations, like the peoples of the lands, serving wood and stone,’ what you have in mind will never come to pass.

units.leftText: As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will be king over you.
units.rightText: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, with a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will rule over you.

units.leftText: I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries in which you are scattered with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.
units.rightText: With a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered.
rightNotes: 20:34 LXX receive you; see also 2 Corinthians 6:17|2CO 6:17*.

units.leftText: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
units.rightText: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, where I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

units.leftText: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you, declares the Lord GOD.
rightNotes: 20:36 Or in the wilderness after bringing them out of Egypt

units.leftText: “I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
units.rightText: I will make you pass under the rod and will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

units.leftText: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: And I will purge you of those who rebel and transgress against Me. I will bring them out of the land in which they dwell, but they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

units.leftText: “‘As for you, house of Israel, the Lord GOD says: “Go, everyone serve his idols, and hereafter also, if you will not listen to me; but you shall no more profane my holy name with your gifts and with your idols.
units.rightText: And as for you, O house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you. But afterward, you will surely listen to Me, and you will no longer defile My holy name with your gifts and idols.

units.leftText: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel,” says the Lord GOD, “there all the house of Israel, all of them, shall serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will require your offerings and the first fruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.
units.rightText: For on My holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, there the whole house of Israel, all of them, will serve Me in the land. There I will accept them and will require your offerings and choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.

units.leftText: I will accept you as a pleasant aroma when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries in which you have been scattered. I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.
units.rightText: When I bring you from the peoples and gather you from the lands to which you have been scattered, I will accept you as a pleasing aroma. And I will show My holiness through you in the sight of the nations.

units.leftText: You will know that I am the LORD when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to your fathers.
units.rightText: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land that I swore to give your fathers.

units.leftText: There you will remember your ways, and all your deeds in which you have polluted yourselves. Then you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed.
units.rightText: There you will remember your ways and all the deeds with which you have defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves for all the evils you have done.

units.leftText: You will know that I am the LORD, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, you house of Israel,” says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: Then you will know, O house of Israel, that I am the LORD, when I have dealt with you for the sake of My name and not according to your wicked ways and corrupt acts, declares the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the south.
units.rightText: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, preach against it, and prophesy against the forest of the Negev.
rightNotes: 20:46 Hebrew toward Teman

units.leftText: Tell the forest of the south, ‘Hear the LORD’s word: The Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree. The burning flame will not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north will be burned by it.
units.rightText: Say to the forest of the Negev: Hear the word of the LORD! This is what the Lord GOD says: I am about to ignite in you a fire, and it will devour all your trees, both green and dry. The blazing flame will not be quenched, and by it every face from south to north will be scorched.

units.leftText: All flesh will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it. It will not be quenched.”’”
units.rightText: Then all people will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it; it will not be quenched.”

units.leftText: Then I said, “Ah Lord GOD! They say of me, ‘Isn’t he a speaker of parables?’”
units.rightText: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD, they are saying of me, ‘Is he not just telling parables?’”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
units.rightText: “Son of man, set your face against Jerusalem and preach against the sanctuaries. Prophesy against the land of Israel

units.leftText: Tell the land of Israel, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
units.rightText: and tell her that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am against you, and I will draw My sword from its sheath and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.

units.leftText: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north.
units.rightText: Because I will cut off both the righteous and the wicked, My sword will be unsheathed against everyone from south to north.

units.leftText: All flesh will know that I, the LORD, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It will not return any more.”’
units.rightText: Then all flesh will know that I, the LORD, have taken My sword from its sheath, not to return it again.’

units.leftText: “Therefore sigh, you son of man. You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.
units.rightText: But you, son of man, groan! Groan before their eyes with a broken heart and bitter grief.
leftNotes: 21:6 literally, the breaking of your thighs

units.leftText: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: And when they ask, ‘Why are you groaning?’ you are to say, ‘Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt, and every hand will go limp. Every spirit will faint, and every knee will turn to water.’ Yes, it is coming and it will surely happen, declares the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The LORD says:
units.rightText: “Son of man, prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord says:

units.leftText: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter.
units.rightText: it is sharpened for the slaughter,

units.leftText: It is given to be polished,
units.rightText: The sword is appointed to be polished,

units.leftText: Cry and wail, son of man;
units.rightText: Cry out and wail,

units.leftText: “For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Surely testing will come!

units.leftText: “You therefore, son of man, prophesy,
units.rightText: ‘So then, son of man,

units.leftText: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates,
units.rightText: So that their hearts may melt

units.leftText: Gather yourselves together.
units.rightText: Slash to the right;

units.leftText: I will also strike my hands together,
units.rightText: I too will strike My hands together,

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me again, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.
units.rightText: “Now you, son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take, both starting from the same land. And make a signpost where the road branches off to each city.

units.leftText: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.
units.rightText: Mark out one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites, and another against Judah into fortified Jerusalem.

units.leftText: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver.
units.rightText: For the king of Babylon stands at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen: He shakes the arrows, he consults the idols, he examines the liver.
leftNotes: 21:21 teraphim were household idols that may have been associated with inheritance rights to the household property.

units.leftText: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, and to build forts.
units.rightText: In his right hand appears the portent for Jerusalem, where he is to set up battering rams, to call for the slaughter, to lift a battle cry, to direct the battering rams against the gates, to build a ramp, and to erect a siege wall.

units.leftText: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to memory, that they may be taken.
units.rightText: It will seem like a false omen to the eyes of those who have sworn allegiance to him, but it will draw attention to their guilt and take them captive.

units.leftText: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have caused your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear; because you have come to memory, you will be taken with the hand.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have drawn attention to your guilt, exposing your transgressions, so that your sins are revealed in all your deeds — because you have come to remembrance — you shall be taken in hand.

units.leftText: “‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
units.rightText: And you, O profane and wicked prince of Israel,

units.leftText: the Lord GOD says: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.”’
units.rightText: A ruin, a ruin,

units.leftText: “You, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘The Lord GOD says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach:
units.rightText: Now prophesy, son of man, and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says concerning the Ammonites and their contempt:

units.leftText: while they see for you false visions,
units.rightText: while they offer false visions for you

units.leftText: Cause it to return into its sheath.
units.rightText: Return the sword to its sheath!

units.leftText: I will pour out my indignation on you.
units.rightText: I will pour out My anger upon you;

units.leftText: You will be for fuel to the fire.
units.rightText: You will be fuel for the fire.

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.
units.rightText: “As for you, son of man, will you judge her? Will you pass judgment on the city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her abominations
