units.leftText: You shall say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “A city that sheds blood within herself, that her time may come, and that makes idols against herself to defile her!
units.rightText: and tell her that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘O city who brings her own doom by shedding blood within her walls and making idols to defile herself,

units.leftText: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed, and are defiled in your idols which you have made! You have caused your days to draw near, and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.
units.rightText: you are guilty of the blood you have shed, and you are defiled by the idols you have made. You have brought your days to a close and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the lands.

units.leftText: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.
units.rightText: Those near and far will mock you, O infamous city, full of turmoil.

units.leftText: “‘“Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.
units.rightText: See how every prince of Israel within you has used his power to shed blood.

units.leftText: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow.
units.rightText: Father and mother are treated with contempt. Within your walls the foreign resident is exploited, the fatherless and the widow are oppressed.
leftNotes: 22:7 Literally, made light of father and mother.

units.leftText: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
units.rightText: You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths.

units.leftText: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.
units.rightText: Among you are slanderous men bent on bloodshed; within you are those who eat on the mountain shrines and commit acts of indecency.

units.leftText: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.
units.rightText: In you they have uncovered the nakedness of their fathers; in you they violate women during their menstrual impurity.

units.leftText: One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife, and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.
units.rightText: One man commits an abomination with his neighbor’s wife; another wickedly defiles his daughter-in-law; and yet another violates his sister, his own father’s daughter.

units.leftText: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: In you they take bribes to shed blood. You engage in usury, take excess interest, and extort your neighbors. But Me you have forgotten, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “‘“Behold, therefore I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at the blood which has been shed within you.
units.rightText: Now look, I strike My hands together against your unjust gain and against the blood you have shed in your midst.

units.leftText: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I will deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken it, and will do it.
units.rightText: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will act.

units.leftText: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you.
units.rightText: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you throughout the lands; I will purge your uncleanness.

units.leftText: You will be profaned in yourself in the sight of the nations. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
units.rightText: And when you have defiled yourself in the eyes of the nations, then you will know that I am the LORD.’”
rightNotes: 22:16 Or And when I have allotted you your inheritance

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. They are the dross of silver.
units.rightText: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them are copper, tin, iron, and lead inside the furnace; they are but the dross of silver.

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because all of you have become dross, behold, I will gather you into Jerusalem.

units.leftText: As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there and melt you.
units.rightText: Just as one gathers silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin into the furnace to melt with a fiery blast, so I will gather you in My anger and wrath, leave you there, and melt you.

units.leftText: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.
units.rightText: Yes, I will gather you together and blow on you with the fire of My wrath, and you will be melted within the city.

units.leftText: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my wrath on you.’”
units.rightText: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted within the city. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out My wrath upon you.’”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, tell her, ‘You are a land that is not cleansed nor rained on in the day of indignation.’
units.rightText: “Son of man, say to her, ‘In the day of indignation, you are a land that has not been cleansed, upon which no rain has fallen.’

units.leftText: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.
units.rightText: The conspiracy of the princes in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing its prey. They devour the people, seize the treasures and precious things, and multiply the widows within her.
rightNotes: 22:25 LXX; Hebrew prophets

units.leftText: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them.
units.rightText: Her priests do violence to My law and profane My holy things. They make no distinction between the holy and the common, and they fail to distinguish between the clean and the unclean. They disregard My Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.

units.leftText: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.
units.rightText: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey, shedding blood, and destroying lives for dishonest gain.

units.leftText: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, ‘The Lord GOD says,’ when the LORD has not spoken.
units.rightText: Her prophets whitewash these deeds by false visions and lying divinations, saying, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ when the LORD has not spoken.

units.leftText: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.
units.rightText: The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery. They have oppressed the poor and needy and have exploited the foreign resident without justice.

units.leftText: “I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.
units.rightText: I searched for a man among them to repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land, so that I should not destroy it. But I found no one.

units.leftText: Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought their own way on their heads,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: So I have poured out My indignation upon them and consumed them with the fire of My fury. I have brought their ways down upon their own heads, declares the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.
units.rightText: “Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother,

units.leftText: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their youthful nipples were caressed there.
units.rightText: and they played in Egypt, prostituting themselves from their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their virgin bosoms caressed.

units.leftText: Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
units.rightText: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah. They became Mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. As for their identities, Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
rightNotes: 23:4 Oholah means her own tent or she worships at a tent shrine, a metaphor for Samaria as an adulteress with Assyria.
23:4 Oholibah means the tent is in her or she is a tent shrine, a metaphor for Jerusalem as an adulterous wife.

units.leftText: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,
units.rightText: Oholah prostituted herself while she was still Mine. She lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians — warriors

units.leftText: who were clothed with blue—governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.
units.rightText: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all desirable young men, horsemen mounted on steeds.

units.leftText: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, all of them the choicest men of Assyria. She defiled herself with the idols of whomever she lusted after.
units.rightText: She offered sexual favors to all the elite of Assyria. She defiled herself with all the idols of those for whom she lusted.

units.leftText: She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They caressed her youthful nipples and they poured out their prostitution on her.
units.rightText: She did not give up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when men slept with her in her youth, caressed her virgin bosom, and poured out their lust upon her.

units.leftText: “Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she doted.
units.rightText: Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, the Assyrians for whom she lusted.

units.leftText: These uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for they executed judgments on her.
units.rightText: They exposed her nakedness, seized her sons and daughters, and put her to the sword. Thus she became a byword among women, and they executed judgment against her.

units.leftText: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.
units.rightText: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved than her sister.

units.leftText: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers—her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.
units.rightText: She too lusted after the Assyrians — governors and commanders, warriors dressed in splendor, horsemen riding on steeds, all desirable young men.

units.leftText: I saw that she was defiled. They both went the same way.
units.rightText: And I saw that she too had defiled herself; both of them had taken the same path.

units.leftText: “She increased her prostitution; for she saw men portrayed on the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with red,
units.rightText: But Oholibah carried her prostitution even further. She saw the men portrayed on the wall, images of the Chaldeans, engraved in vermilion,
rightNotes: 23:14 That is, the Babylonians

units.leftText: dressed with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like princes, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.
units.rightText: wearing belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like officers of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.
rightNotes: 23:15 Or Babylonia; also in verse 16

units.leftText: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.
units.rightText: At the sight of them, she lusted for them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea.

units.leftText: The Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution. She was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.
units.rightText: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust they defiled her. But after she had been defiled by them, she turned away in disgust.

units.leftText: So she uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her nakedness. Then my soul was alienated from her, just like my soul was alienated from her sister.
units.rightText: When Oholibah openly prostituted herself and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.

units.leftText: Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, in which she had played the prostitute in the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: Yet she multiplied her promiscuity, remembering the days of her youth, when she had prostituted herself in the land of Egypt

units.leftText: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh is as the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
units.rightText: and lusted after their lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of stallions.

units.leftText: Thus you called to memory the lewdness of your youth, in the caressing of your nipples by the Egyptians because of your youthful breasts.
units.rightText: So you revisited the indecency of your youth, when the Egyptians caressed your bosom and pressed your young breasts.

units.leftText: “Therefore, Oholibah, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your soul is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side:
units.rightText: Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will incite your lovers against you, those from whom you turned away in disgust. And I will bring them against you from every side —

units.leftText: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, princes and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.
units.rightText: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them— all desirable young men, governors and commanders, officers and men of renown, mounted on horses.

units.leftText: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.
units.rightText: They will come against you with a host of peoples, with weapons, chariots, and wagons. They will array themselves against you on every side with buckler and shield and helmet. I will delegate judgment to them, and they will punish you according to their own standards.
rightNotes: 23:24 LXX They will all come against you from the north

units.leftText: I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will take away your nose and your ears. Your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and the rest of you will be devoured by the fire.
units.rightText: And I will set My jealous rage against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your noses and ears, and your survivors will fall by the sword. They will seize your sons and daughters, and your remnant will be consumed by fire.

units.leftText: They will also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.
units.rightText: They will strip off your clothes and take your fine jewelry.

units.leftText: Thus I will make your lewdness to cease from you, and remove your prostitution from the land of Egypt, so that you will not lift up your eyes to them, nor remember Egypt any more.’
units.rightText: So I will put an end to your indecency and prostitution, which began in the land of Egypt, and you will not lift your eyes to them or remember Egypt anymore.’

units.leftText: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your soul is alienated.
units.rightText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Surely I will deliver you into the hands of those you hate, from whom you turned away in disgust.

units.leftText: They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.
units.rightText: They will treat you with hatred, take all for which you have worked, and leave you naked and bare, so that the shame of your prostitution will be exposed. Your indecency and promiscuity

units.leftText: These things will be done to you because you have played the prostitute after the nations, and because you are polluted with their idols.
units.rightText: have brought these things upon you, because you have prostituted yourself with the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.

units.leftText: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.’
units.rightText: Because you have followed the path of your sister, I will put her cup into your hand.’

units.leftText: “The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow,
units.rightText: You will be filled with drunkenness and grief,

units.leftText: You will even drink it and drain it out.
units.rightText: You will drink it and drain it;

units.leftText: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.’”
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have forgotten Me and have cast Me behind your back, you must bear the consequences of your indecency and prostitution.’”

units.leftText: The LORD said moreover to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
units.rightText: Then the LORD said to me: “Son of man, will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.

units.leftText: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured.
units.rightText: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have even sacrificed their children, whom they bore to Me, in the fire as food for their idols.
rightNotes: 23:37 Literally passed their children, whom they bore to Me, through the fire

units.leftText: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
units.rightText: They have also done this to Me: On that very same day, they defiled My sanctuary and profaned My Sabbaths.

units.leftText: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, they have done this in the middle of my house.
units.rightText: On the very day they slaughtered their children for their idols, they entered My sanctuary to profane it. Yes, they did this inside My house.

units.leftText: “Furthermore you sisters have sent for men who come from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and behold, they came; for whom you washed yourself, painted your eyes, decorated yourself with ornaments,
units.rightText: Furthermore, you sisters sent messengers for men who came from afar; and behold, when they arrived, you bathed for them, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with jewelry.
rightNotes: 23:40 Hebrew they sent

units.leftText: and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil.
units.rightText: You sat on a couch of luxury with a table spread before it, on which you had set My incense and My oil,

units.leftText: “The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.
units.rightText: accompanied by the sound of a carefree crowd. Drunkards were brought in from the desert along with men from the rabble, who put bracelets on your wrists and beautiful crowns on your head.
rightNotes: 23:42 Or Sabeans

units.leftText: Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.’
units.rightText: Then I said of her who had grown old in adulteries: ‘Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is!’

units.leftText: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.
units.rightText: And they slept with her as with a prostitute; they slept with Oholah and Oholibah, those lewd women.

units.leftText: Righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
units.rightText: But righteous men will sentence them to the punishment of those who commit adultery and bloodshed, because they are adulteresses with blood on their hands.

units.leftText: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Bring a mob against them and consign them to terror and plunder.

units.leftText: The company will stone them with stones and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
units.rightText: The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses.

units.leftText: “‘Thus I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you.
units.rightText: So I will put an end to indecency in the land, and all the women will be admonished not to imitate your behavior.

units.leftText: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: They will repay you for your indecency, and you will bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”

units.leftText: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: In the ninth year, on the tenth day of the tenth month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.
units.rightText: “Son of man, write down today’s date, for on this very day the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem.

units.leftText: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says,
units.rightText: Now speak a parable to this rebellious house and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: Gather its pieces into it,
units.rightText: Put in the pieces of meat,

units.leftText: Take the choice of the flock,
units.rightText: Take the choicest of the flock

units.leftText: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: “‘“For the blood she shed is in the middle of her.
units.rightText: For the blood she shed is still within her;

units.leftText: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance,
units.rightText: In order to stir up wrath

units.leftText: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Yes, this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: Heap on the wood.
units.rightText: Pile on the logs and kindle the fire;

units.leftText: Then set it empty on its coals,
units.rightText: Set the empty pot on its coals

units.leftText: She is weary with toil;
units.rightText: It has frustrated every effort;

units.leftText: “‘“In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren’t cleansed, you won’t be cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I have caused my wrath toward you to rest.
units.rightText: Because of the indecency of your uncleanness

units.leftText: “‘“I, the LORD, have spoken it. It will happen, and I will do it. I won’t go back. I won’t spare. I won’t repent. According to your ways and according to your doings, they will judge you,” says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: I, the LORD, have spoken;

units.leftText: Also the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.
units.rightText: “Son of man, behold, I am about to take away the desire of your eyes with a fatal blow. But you must not mourn or weep or let your tears flow.

units.leftText: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”
units.rightText: Groan quietly; do not mourn for the dead. Put on your turban and strap your sandals on your feet; do not cover your lips or eat the bread of mourners.”

units.leftText: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.
units.rightText: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. And the next morning I did as I had been commanded.

units.leftText: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”
units.rightText: Then the people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things you are doing mean to us?”

units.leftText: Then I said to them, “The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: So I answered them, “The word of the LORD came to me, saying:

units.leftText: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.
units.rightText: Tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I am about to desecrate My sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and the delight of your soul. And the sons and daughters you left behind will fall by the sword.’

units.leftText: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.
units.rightText: Then you will do as I have done: You will not cover your lips or eat the bread of mourners.

units.leftText: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.
units.rightText: Your turbans will remain on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep, but you will waste away because of your sins, and you will groan among yourselves.

units.leftText: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”’”
units.rightText: ‘Thus Ezekiel will be a sign for you; you will do everything that he has done. When this happens, you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’

units.leftText: “You, son of man, shouldn’t it be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart—their sons and their daughters—
units.rightText: And you, son of man, know that on the day I take away their stronghold, their pride and joy — the desire of their eyes which uplifted their souls — and their sons and daughters as well,

units.leftText: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?
units.rightText: on that day a fugitive will come and tell you the news.

units.leftText: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: On that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped; you will speak and no longer be mute. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD.”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.
units.rightText: “Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

units.leftText: Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord GOD! The Lord GOD says, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,
units.rightText: Tell the Ammonites to hear the word of the Lord GOD, for this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you exclaimed, “Aha!” when My sanctuary was profaned, when the land of Israel was laid waste, and when the house of Judah went into exile,

units.leftText: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.
units.rightText: therefore I will indeed give you as a possession to the people of the East. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you. They will eat your fruit and drink your milk.

units.leftText: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels, and Ammon a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
rightNotes: 25:5 Hebrew and the Ammonites

units.leftText: For the Lord GOD says: “Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,
units.rightText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you clapped your hands and stomped your feet and rejoiced over the land of Israel with a heart full of contempt,

units.leftText: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: therefore I will indeed stretch out My hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples and exterminate you from the countries. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.’

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because Moab and Seir said, “Look, the house of Judah is like all the other nations,”
rightNotes: 25:8 LXX does not include and Seir.

units.leftText: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,
units.rightText: therefore I will indeed expose the flank of Moab beginning with its frontier cities — Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim — the glory of the land.

units.leftText: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.
units.rightText: I will give it along with the Ammonites as a possession to the people of the East, so that the Ammonites will no longer be remembered among the nations.

units.leftText: I will execute judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: So I will execute judgments on Moab, and they will know that I am the LORD.’

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,”
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because Edom acted vengefully against the house of Judah, and in so doing incurred grievous guilt,

units.leftText: therefore the Lord GOD says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.
units.rightText: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stretch out My hand against Edom and cut off from it both man and beast. I will make it a wasteland, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.

units.leftText: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Then they will know my vengeance,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: I will take My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel, and they will deal with Edom according to My anger and wrath. Then they will know My vengeance, declares the Lord GOD.’

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility,”
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because the Philistines acted in vengeance, taking vengeance with malice of soul to destroy Judah with ancient hostility,

units.leftText: therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
units.rightText: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I will stretch out My hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy the remnant along the coast.

units.leftText: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”
units.rightText: I will execute great vengeance against them with furious reproof. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay My vengeance upon them.’”

units.leftText: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
rightNotes: 26:1 Likely reading of the original Hebrew text; MT In the eleventh year

units.leftText: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’
units.rightText: “Son of man, because Tyre has said of Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gate to the nations is broken; it has swung open to me; now that she lies in ruins I will be filled,’

units.leftText: therefore the Lord GOD says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.
units.rightText: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, O Tyre, I am against you, and I will raise up many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves.

units.leftText: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
units.rightText: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and demolish her towers. I will scrape the soil from her and make her a bare rock.

units.leftText: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.
units.rightText: She will become a place to spread nets in the sea, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD. She will become plunder for the nations,

units.leftText: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
units.rightText: and the villages on her mainland will be slain by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’

units.leftText: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.
units.rightText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will bring against Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, with cavalry and a great company of troops.
rightNotes: 26:7 Hebrew Nebuchadrezzar, a variant of Nebuchadnezzar (king of Babylon). The latter spelling is used throughout Ezekiel for consistency.

units.leftText: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.
units.rightText: He will slaughter the villages of your mainland with the sword; he will set up siege works against you, build a ramp to your walls, and raise his shields against you.

units.leftText: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.
units.rightText: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and tear down your towers with his axes.

units.leftText: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.
units.rightText: His multitude of horses will cover you in their dust.

units.leftText: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.
units.rightText: The hooves of his horses will trample all your streets. He will slaughter your people with the sword, and your mighty pillars will fall to the ground.

units.leftText: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.
units.rightText: They will plunder your wealth and pillage your merchandise. They will demolish your walls, tear down your beautiful homes, and throw your stones and timber and soil into the water.

units.leftText: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.
units.rightText: So I will silence the sound of your songs, and the music of your lyres will no longer be heard.

units.leftText: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I the LORD have spoken it,’ says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: I will make you a bare rock, and you will become a place to spread the fishing nets. You will never be rebuilt, for I, the LORD, have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.’

units.leftText: “The Lord GOD says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says to Tyre: ‘Will not the coastlands quake at the sound of your downfall, when the wounded groan at the slaughter in your midst?

units.leftText: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.
units.rightText: All the princes of the sea will descend from their thrones, remove their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled over you.

units.leftText: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you,
units.rightText: Then they will lament for you, saying,

units.leftText: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall.
units.rightText: Now the coastlands tremble

units.leftText: “For the Lord GOD says: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,
units.rightText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When I make you a desolate city like other deserted cities, and when I raise up the deep against you so that the mighty waters cover you,

units.leftText: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.
units.rightText: then I will bring you down with those who descend to the Pit, to the people of antiquity. I will make you dwell in the earth below like the ancient ruins, with those who descend to the Pit, so that you will no longer be inhabited or set in splendor in the land of the living.
rightNotes: 26:20 LXX or take your place

units.leftText: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: I will make you an object of horror, and you will be no more. You will be sought, but will never be found,’ declares the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;
units.rightText: “Now you, son of man, take up a lament for Tyre.

units.leftText: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Tell Tyre, who dwells at the gateway to the sea, merchant of the peoples on many coasts, that this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: Your borders are in the heart of the seas.
units.rightText: Your borders are in the heart of the seas;

units.leftText: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir.
units.rightText: They constructed all your planking

units.leftText: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan.
units.rightText: Of oaks from Bashan

units.leftText: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt,
units.rightText: Of embroidered fine linen from Egypt

units.leftText: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers.
units.rightText: The men of Sidon and Arvad

units.leftText: The old men of Gebal
units.rightText: The elders of Gebal were aboard as shipwrights,

units.leftText: “‘“Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army,
units.rightText: Men of Persia, Lydia, and Put

units.leftText: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around,
units.rightText: Men of Arvad and Helech

units.leftText: “‘“Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.
units.rightText: Tarshish was your merchant because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin, and lead for your wares.

units.leftText: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.
units.rightText: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your merchants. They exchanged slaves and bronze utensils for your merchandise.
rightNotes: 27:13 That is, Greece

units.leftText: “‘“They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.
units.rightText: The men of Beth-togarmah exchanged horses, war horses, and mules for your wares.

units.leftText: “‘“The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.
units.rightText: The men of Dedan were your clients; many coastlands were your market; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.
rightNotes: 27:15 Hebrew; LXX Rhodes

units.leftText: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.
units.rightText: Aram was your customer because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies for your wares.
rightNotes: 27:16 Most Hebrew manuscripts; some Hebrew manuscripts and Syriac Edom

units.leftText: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.
units.rightText: Judah and the land of Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith, cakes and honey, oil and balm for your merchandise.

units.leftText: “‘“Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
units.rightText: Because of your many products and your great wealth of goods, Damascus traded with you wine from Helbon, wool from Zahar,

units.leftText: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.
units.rightText: and casks of wine from Izal for your wares. Wrought iron, cassia, and sweet cane were exchanged for your merchandise.
rightNotes: 27:19 Probable reading; MT —and Dan and Javan from Uzal (traded) for your wares
27:19 Or calamus
27:19 Or were among your merchandise

units.leftText: “‘“Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding.
units.rightText: Dedan was your merchant in saddlecloths for riding.

units.leftText: “‘“Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants.
units.rightText: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your customers, trading in lambs, rams, and goats.

units.leftText: “‘“The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the best of all spices, all precious stones, and gold.
units.rightText: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; for your wares they exchanged gold, the finest of all spices, and precious stones.

units.leftText: “‘“Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.
units.rightText: Haran, Canneh, and Eden traded with you, and so did the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad.

units.leftText: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise.
units.rightText: In your marketplace they traded with you fine garments of blue, embroidered work, and multicolored rugs with cords tightly twisted and knotted.

units.leftText: “‘“The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise.
units.rightText: The ships of Tarshish
rightNotes: 27:25 Or A fleet of trading ships

units.leftText: Your rowers have brought you into great waters.
units.rightText: Your oarsmen have brought you

units.leftText: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise,
units.rightText: Your wealth, wares, and merchandise,

units.leftText: At the sound of the cry of your pilots,
units.rightText: The countryside will shake

units.leftText: All who handle the oars,
units.rightText: All who handle the oars

units.leftText: and will cause their voice to be heard over you,
units.rightText: They will raise their voices for you

units.leftText: They will make themselves bald for you,
units.rightText: They will shave their heads for you

units.leftText: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you,
units.rightText: As they wail and mourn over you,

units.leftText: When your wares came from the seas,
units.rightText: When your wares went out to sea,

units.leftText: In the time that you were broken by the seas,
units.rightText: Now you are shattered by the seas

units.leftText: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you,
units.rightText: All the people of the coastlands

units.leftText: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you.
units.rightText: Those who trade among the nations

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: “Son of man, tell the ruler of Tyre that this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: behold, you are wiser than Daniel.
units.rightText: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel;

units.leftText: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches,
units.rightText: By your wisdom and understanding

units.leftText: By your great wisdom
units.rightText: By your great skill in trading

units.leftText: “‘therefore the Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you,
units.rightText: behold, I will bring foreigners against you,

units.leftText: They will bring you down to the pit.
units.rightText: They will bring you down to the Pit,

units.leftText: Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’?
units.rightText: Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’

units.leftText: You will die the death of the uncircumcised
units.rightText: You will die the death of the uncircumcised

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: “Son of man, take up a lament for the king of Tyre and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: You were in Eden,
units.rightText: You were in Eden,

units.leftText: You were the anointed cherub who covers.
units.rightText: You were anointed as a guardian cherub,

units.leftText: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created,
units.rightText: From the day you were created

units.leftText: By the abundance of your commerce, your insides were filled with violence,
units.rightText: By the vastness of your trade,

units.leftText: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty.
units.rightText: Your heart grew proud of your beauty;

units.leftText: By the multitude of your iniquities,
units.rightText: By the multitude of your iniquities

units.leftText: All those who know you among the peoples will be astonished at you.
units.rightText: All the nations who know you

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,
units.rightText: “Son of man, set your face against Sidon and prophesy against her.

units.leftText: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: And you are to declare that this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: For I will send pestilence into her,
units.rightText: I will send a plague against her

units.leftText: “‘“There will no longer be a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: For the people of Israel will no longer face a pricking brier or a painful thorn from all around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.’

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, I will show Myself holy among them in the sight of the nations.

units.leftText: They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely when I have executed judgments on all those around them who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.”’”
units.rightText: And there they will dwell securely, build houses, and plant vineyards. They will dwell securely when I execute judgments against all those around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.’”

units.leftText: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: In the tenth year, on the twelfth day of the tenth month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
units.rightText: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

units.leftText: Speak and say, ‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: Speak to him and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: I will put hooks in your jaws,
units.rightText: But I will put hooks in your jaws

units.leftText: I’ll cast you out into the wilderness,
units.rightText: I will leave you in the desert,

units.leftText: “‘“All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
units.rightText: Then all the people of Egypt

units.leftText: When they took hold of you by your hand, you broke and tore all their shoulders. When they leaned on you, you broke and paralyzed all of their thighs.”
units.rightText: When Israel took hold of you with their hands,

units.leftText: “‘Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will bring a sword on you, and will cut off man and animal from you.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will bring a sword against you and cut off from you man and beast.

units.leftText: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: The land of Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

units.leftText: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.
units.rightText: therefore I am against you and against your rivers. I will turn the land of Egypt into a ruin, a desolate wasteland from Migdol to Syene, and as far as the border of Cush.
rightNotes: 29:10 That is, the upper Nile region

units.leftText: No foot of man will pass through it, nor will any animal foot pass through it. It won’t be inhabited for forty years.
units.rightText: No foot of man or beast will pass through, and it will be uninhabited for forty years.

units.leftText: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities among the cities that are laid waste will be a desolation forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.”
units.rightText: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation among desolate lands, and her cities will lie desolate for forty years among the ruined cities. And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the countries.

units.leftText: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.
units.rightText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations to which they were scattered.

units.leftText: I will reverse the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth. There they will be a lowly kingdom.
units.rightText: I will restore Egypt from captivity and bring them back to the land of Pathros, the land of their origin. There they will be a lowly kingdom.
rightNotes: 29:14 Or restore the fortunes of Egypt

units.leftText: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms. It won’t lift itself up above the nations any more. I will diminish them so that they will no longer rule over the nations.
units.rightText: Egypt will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the nations. For I will diminish Egypt so that it will never again rule over the nations.

units.leftText: It will no longer be the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to memory, when they turn to look after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”’”
units.rightText: Egypt will never again be an object of trust for the house of Israel, but will remind them of their iniquity in turning to the Egyptians. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: It came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: In the twenty-seventh year, on the first day of the first month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet he had no wages, nor did his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.
units.rightText: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to labor strenuously against Tyre. Every head was made bald and every shoulder made raw. But he and his army received no wages from Tyre for the labor they expended on it.

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry off her multitude, take her plunder, and take her prey. That will be the wages for his army.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will carry off its wealth, seize its spoil, and remove its plunder. This will be the wages for his army.

units.leftText: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: I have given him the land of Egypt as the reward for his labor, because it was done for Me, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth to speak among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: “Son of man, prophesy and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: For the day is near,
units.rightText: For the day is near,

units.leftText: A sword will come on Egypt,
units.rightText: A sword will come against Egypt,

units.leftText: “‘“Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all the mixed people, Cub, and the children of the land that is allied with them, will fall with them by the sword.”
units.rightText: Cush, Put, and Lud,
rightNotes: 30:5 Or Lydia

units.leftText: “‘The LORD says:
units.rightText: For this is what the LORD says:

units.leftText: “They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate.
units.rightText: They will be desolate among desolate lands,

units.leftText: They will know that I am the LORD
units.rightText: Then they will know that I am the LORD

units.leftText: “‘“In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid. There will be anguish on them, as in the day of Egypt; for, behold, it comes.”
units.rightText: On that day messengers will go out from Me in ships to frighten Cush out of complacency. Anguish will come upon them on the day of Egypt’s doom. For it is indeed coming.
rightNotes: 30:9 Hebrew the day of Egypt

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: He and his people with him,
units.rightText: He and his people with him,

units.leftText: I will make the rivers dry,
units.rightText: I will make the streams dry up

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: I will make Pathros desolate,
units.rightText: I will lay waste Pathros,

units.leftText: I will pour my wrath on Sin,
units.rightText: I will pour out My wrath on Pelusium,
rightNotes: 30:15 Hebrew Sin; also in verse 16

units.leftText: I will set a fire in Egypt
units.rightText: I will set fire to Egypt,

units.leftText: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword.
units.rightText: The young men of On and Pi-beseth
rightNotes: 30:17 That is, Heliopolis and Bubastis, as in LXX; Hebrew Aven and Pi-beseth

units.leftText: At Tehaphnehes also the day will withdraw itself,
units.rightText: The day will be darkened in Tahpanhes

units.leftText: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt.
units.rightText: So I will execute judgment on Egypt,

units.leftText: In the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: In the eleventh year, on the seventh day of the first month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Behold, it has not been bound up, to apply medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it may become strong to hold the sword.
units.rightText: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. See, it has not been bound up for healing, or splinted for strength to hold the sword.

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong arm, and that which was broken. I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break his arms, both the strong one and the one already broken, and will make the sword fall from his hand.

units.leftText: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
units.rightText: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.

units.leftText: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand; but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before the king of Babylon with the groaning of a mortally wounded man.
units.rightText: I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king and place My sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, who will groan before him like a mortally wounded man.

units.leftText: I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall down. Then they will know that I am the LORD when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he stretches it out on the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king, but Pharaoh’s arms will fall limp.

units.leftText: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
units.rightText: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”

units.leftText: In the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the third month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt and his multitude:
units.rightText: “Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude:

units.leftText: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon
units.rightText: Look at Assyria, a cedar in Lebanon,

units.leftText: The waters nourished it.
units.rightText: The waters made it grow;

units.leftText: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field;
units.rightText: Therefore it towered higher

units.leftText: All the birds of the sky made their nests in its boughs.
units.rightText: All the birds of the air

units.leftText: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness,
units.rightText: It was beautiful in its greatness,

units.leftText: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it.
units.rightText: The cedars in the garden of God

units.leftText: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches,
units.rightText: I made it beautiful with its many branches,

units.leftText: “Therefore thus said the Lord GOD: ‘Because he is exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick branches, and his heart is lifted up in his height,
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Since it became great in height and set its top among the clouds, and it grew proud on account of its height,
rightNotes: 31:10 Hebrew you became great
31:10 Or through the thick boughs

units.leftText: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness.
units.rightText: I delivered it into the hand of the ruler of the nations, for him to deal with it according to its wickedness. I have banished it.

units.leftText: Foreigners, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land. All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him.
units.rightText: Foreigners, the most ruthless of the nations, cut it down and left it. Its branches have fallen on the mountains and in every valley; its boughs lay broken in all the earth’s ravines. And all the peoples of the earth left its shade and abandoned it.

units.leftText: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches,
units.rightText: All the birds of the air nested on its fallen trunk, and all the beasts of the field lived among its boughs.

units.leftText: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’
units.rightText: This happened so that no other trees by the waters would become great in height and set their tops among the clouds, and no other well-watered trees would reach them in height. For they have all been consigned to death, to the depths of the earth, among the mortals who descend to the Pit.’

units.leftText: “The Lord GOD says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘On the day it was brought down to Sheol, I caused mourning. I covered the deep because of it; I held back its rivers; its abundant waters were restrained. I made Lebanon mourn for it, and all the trees of the field fainted because of it.
leftNotes: 31:15 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.
units.rightText: I made the nations quake at the sound of its downfall, when I cast it down to Sheol with those who descend to the Pit.
leftNotes: 31:16 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: They also went down into Sheol with him to those who are slain by the sword; yes, those who were his arm, who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations.
units.rightText: They too descended with it to Sheol, to those slain by the sword. As its allies they had lived in its shade among the nations.

units.leftText: “‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword.
units.rightText: Who then is like you in glory and greatness among the trees of Eden? You also will be brought down to the depths of the earth to be with the trees of Eden. You will lie among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord GOD.’”

units.leftText: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: In the twelfth year, on the first day of the twelfth month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him,
units.rightText: “Son of man, take up a lament for Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him:

units.leftText: The Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: I will leave you on the land.
units.rightText: I will abandon you on the land

units.leftText: I will lay your flesh on the mountains,
units.rightText: I will put your flesh on the mountains

units.leftText: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood,
units.rightText: I will drench the land

units.leftText: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens
units.rightText: When I extinguish you,

units.leftText: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you,
units.rightText: All the shining lights in the heavens

units.leftText: “I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples,
units.rightText: ‘I will trouble the hearts of many peoples,

units.leftText: Yes, I will make many peoples amazed at you,
units.rightText: I will cause many peoples

units.leftText: For the Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: For this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty.
units.rightText: I will make your hordes fall

units.leftText: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters.
units.rightText: I will slaughter all her cattle

units.leftText: Then I will make their waters clear,
units.rightText: Then I will let her waters settle

units.leftText: “When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste,
units.rightText: ‘When I make the land of Egypt a desolation

units.leftText: “‘“This is the lamentation with which they will lament. The daughters of the nations will lament with this. They will lament with it over Egypt, and over all her multitude,” says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: This is the lament they will chant for her; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and all her multitudes they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: Also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
rightNotes: 32:17 Presumably the fifteenth day of the twelfth month (see verse 1); LXX on the fifteenth day of the first month.

units.leftText: “Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down into the pit.
units.rightText: “Son of man, wail for the multitudes of Egypt, and consign her and the daughters of the mighty nations to the depths of the earth with those who descend to the Pit:

units.leftText: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.
units.rightText: Whom do you surpass in beauty?

units.leftText: They will fall among those who are slain by the sword. She is delivered to the sword. Draw her away with all her multitudes.
units.rightText: They will fall among those slain by the sword.

units.leftText: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword.
units.rightText: Mighty chiefs will speak from the midst of Sheol
leftNotes: 32:21 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: “Asshur is there with all her company. Her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword,
units.rightText: Assyria is there with her whole company;

units.leftText: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.
units.rightText: Her graves are set in the depths of the Pit,

units.leftText: “There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit.
units.rightText: Elam is there

units.leftText: They have made Elam a bed among the slain with all her multitude. Her graves are around her, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit. He is put among those who are slain.
units.rightText: Among the slain they prepare

units.leftText: “There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude. Their graves are around them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.
units.rightText: Meshech and Tubal are there

units.leftText: They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war and have laid their swords under their heads. Their iniquities are on their bones; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
units.rightText: They do not lie down

units.leftText: “But you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and will lie with those who are slain by the sword.
units.rightText: But you too will be shattered

units.leftText: “There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, who in their might are laid with those who are slain by the sword. They will lie with the uncircumcised, and with those who go down to the pit.
units.rightText: Edom is there,

units.leftText: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might. They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
units.rightText: All the leaders of the north

units.leftText: “Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Pharaoh will see them

units.leftText: “For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: For I will spread My terror

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman,
units.rightText: “Son of man, speak to your people and tell them: ‘Suppose I bring the sword against a land, and the people of that land choose a man from among them, appointing him as their watchman,

units.leftText: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,
units.rightText: and he sees the sword coming against that land and blows the ram’s horn to warn the people.

units.leftText: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn’t heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
units.rightText: Then if anyone hears the sound of the horn but fails to heed the warning, and the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.

units.leftText: He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn’t take warning. His blood will be on him; whereas if he had heeded the warning, he would have delivered his soul.
units.rightText: Since he heard the sound of the horn but failed to heed the warning, his blood will be on his own head. If he had heeded the warning, he would have saved his life.

units.leftText: But if the watchman sees the sword come and doesn’t blow the trumpet, and the people aren’t warned, and the sword comes and takes any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at the watchman’s hand.’
units.rightText: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and fails to blow the horn to warn the people, and the sword comes and takes away a life, then that one will be taken away in his iniquity, but I will hold the watchman accountable for his blood.’

units.leftText: “So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.
