units.rightText: As for you, O son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word from My mouth and give them the warning from Me.

units.leftText: When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood at your hand.
units.rightText: If I say to the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ but you do not speak out to dissuade him from his way, then that wicked man will die in his iniquity, yet I will hold you accountable for his blood.

units.leftText: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.
units.rightText: But if you warn the wicked man to turn from his way, and he does not turn from it, he will die in his iniquity, but you will have saved your life.

units.leftText: “You, son of man, tell the house of Israel: ‘You say this, “Our transgressions and our sins are on us, and we pine away in them. How then can we live?”’
units.rightText: Now as for you, son of man, tell the house of Israel that this is what they have said: ‘Our transgressions and our sins are heavy upon us, and we are wasting away because of them! How can we live?’

units.leftText: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’
units.rightText: Say to them: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked should turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! For why should you die, O house of Israel?’

units.leftText: “You, son of man, tell the children of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his disobedience. And as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not fall by it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither will he who is righteous be able to live by it in the day that he sins.
units.rightText: Therefore, son of man, say to your people: ‘The righteousness of the righteous man will not deliver him in the day of his transgression; neither will the wickedness of the wicked man cause him to stumble on the day he turns from his wickedness. Nor will the righteous man be able to survive by his righteousness on the day he sins.’

units.leftText: When I tell the righteous that he will surely live, if he trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but he will die in his iniquity that he has committed.
units.rightText: If I tell the righteous man that he will surely live, but he then trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, then none of his righteous works will be remembered; he will die because of the iniquity he has committed.

units.leftText: Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,
units.rightText: But if I tell the wicked man, ‘You will surely die,’ and he turns from his sin and does what is just and right—

units.leftText: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die.
units.rightText: if he restores a pledge, makes restitution for what he has stolen, and walks in the statutes of life without practicing iniquity— then he will surely live; he will not die.

units.leftText: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.
units.rightText: None of the sins he has committed will be held against him. He has done what is just and right; he will surely live.

units.leftText: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.
units.rightText: Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But it is their way that is not just.

units.leftText: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.
units.rightText: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will die for it.

units.leftText: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.
units.rightText: But if a wicked man turns from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he will live because of this.

units.leftText: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’”
units.rightText: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to his ways, O house of Israel.”

units.leftText: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been defeated!”
units.rightText: In the twelfth year of our exile, on the fifth day of the tenth month, a fugitive from Jerusalem came to me and reported, “The city has been taken!”

units.leftText: Now the LORD’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.
units.rightText: Now the evening before the fugitive arrived, the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer mute.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.’
units.rightText: “Son of man, those living in the ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as a possession.’

units.leftText: Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. So should you possess the land?
units.rightText: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You eat meat with the blood in it, lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. Should you then possess the land?

units.leftText: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?”’
units.rightText: You have relied on your swords, you have committed detestable acts, and each of you has defiled his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’

units.leftText: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.
units.rightText: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘As surely as I live, those in the ruins will fall by the sword, those in the open field I will give to be devoured by wild animals, and those in the strongholds and caves will die by plague.

units.leftText: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.
units.rightText: I will make the land a desolate waste, and the pride of her strength will come to an end. The mountains of Israel will become desolate, so that no one will pass through.

units.leftText: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.”’
units.rightText: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the abominations they have committed.’

units.leftText: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from the LORD.’
units.rightText: As for you, son of man, your people are talking about you near the city walls and in the doorways of their houses. One speaks to another, each saying to his brother, ‘Come and hear the message that has come from the LORD!’

units.leftText: They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.
units.rightText: So My people come to you as usual, sit before you, and hear your words; but they do not put them into practice. Although they express love with their mouths, their hearts pursue dishonest gain.

units.leftText: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.
units.rightText: Indeed, you are to them like a singer of love songs with a beautiful voice, who skillfully plays an instrument. They hear your words but do not put them into practice.

units.leftText: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
units.rightText: So when it comes to pass— and surely it will come— then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?
units.rightText: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who only feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed their flock?

units.leftText: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.
units.rightText: You eat the fat, wear the wool, and butcher the fattened sheep, but you do not feed the flock.

units.leftText: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.
units.rightText: You have not strengthened the weak, healed the sick, bound up the injured, brought back the strays, or searched for the lost. Instead, you have ruled them with violence and cruelty.

units.leftText: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.
units.rightText: They were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild beasts.

units.leftText: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”
units.rightText: My flock went astray on all the mountains and every high hill. They were scattered over the face of all the earth, with no one to search for them or seek them out.’

units.leftText: “‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word:
units.rightText: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:

units.leftText: “As I live,” says the Lord GOD, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,
units.rightText: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because My flock lacks a shepherd and has become prey and food for every wild beast, and because My shepherds did not search for My flock but fed themselves instead,

units.leftText: therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD’s word!”
units.rightText: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD!’

units.leftText: The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand from them My flock and remove them from tending the flock, so that they can no longer feed themselves. For I will deliver My flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.’

units.leftText: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
units.rightText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out.

units.leftText: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
units.rightText: As a shepherd looks for his scattered sheep when he is among the flock, so I will look for My flock.

units.leftText: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
units.rightText: I will bring them out from the peoples, gather them from the countries, and bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines, and in all the settlements of the land.

units.leftText: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
units.rightText: I will feed them in good pasture, and the lofty mountains of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in a good grazing land; they will feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

units.leftText: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: I will tend My flock and make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’
units.rightText: I will seek the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the broken, and strengthen the weak; but the sleek and strong I will destroy. I will shepherd them with justice.’

units.leftText: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says to you, My flock: ‘I will judge between one sheep and another, between the rams and the goats.

units.leftText: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?
units.rightText: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of the pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink the clear waters? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?

units.leftText: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’
units.rightText: Why must My flock feed on what your feet have trampled, and drink what your feet have muddied?’

units.leftText: “Therefore the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

units.leftText: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,
units.rightText: Since you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak ones with your horns until you have scattered them abroad,

units.leftText: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.
units.rightText: I will save My flock, and they will no longer be prey. I will judge between one sheep and another.

units.leftText: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.
units.rightText: I will appoint over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will feed them. He will feed them and be their shepherd.

units.leftText: I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken it.
units.rightText: I, the LORD, will be their God, and My servant David will be a prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken.

units.leftText: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.
units.rightText: I will make with them a covenant of peace and rid the land of wild animals, so that they may dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the forest.

units.leftText: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.
units.rightText: I will make them and the places around My hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season— showers of blessing.

units.leftText: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.
units.rightText: The trees of the field will give their fruit, and the land will yield its produce; My flock will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke and delivered them from the hands that enslaved them.

units.leftText: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.
units.rightText: They will no longer be prey for the nations, and the beasts of the earth will not consume them. They will dwell securely, and no one will frighten them.

units.leftText: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.
units.rightText: And I will raise up for them a garden of renown, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the nations.

units.leftText: They will know that I, the LORD, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are My people,’ declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: ‘You are My flock, the sheep of My pasture, My people, and I am your God,’ declares the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
units.rightText: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it,

units.leftText: and tell it, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.
units.rightText: and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says:

units.leftText: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: I will turn your cities into ruins,

units.leftText: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
units.rightText: Because you harbored an ancient hatred and delivered the Israelites over to the sword in the time of their disaster at the final stage of their punishment,

units.leftText: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.
units.rightText: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, it will pursue you.

units.leftText: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.
units.rightText: I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and will cut off from it those who come and go.

units.leftText: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.
units.rightText: I will fill its mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your ravines.

units.leftText: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

units.leftText: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although the LORD was there,
units.rightText: Because you have said, ‘These two nations and countries will be ours, and we will possess them,’ even though the LORD was there,

units.leftText: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
units.rightText: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will treat you according to the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred against them, and I will make Myself known among them when I judge you.

units.leftText: You will know that I, the LORD, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’
units.rightText: Then you will know that I, the LORD, have heard every contemptuous word you uttered against the mountains of Israel when you said, ‘They are desolate; they are given to us to devour!’

units.leftText: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”
units.rightText: You boasted against Me with your mouth and multiplied your words against Me. I heard it Myself!

units.leftText: The Lord GOD says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

units.leftText: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
units.rightText: As you rejoiced when the inheritance of the house of Israel became desolate, so will I do to you. You will become a desolation, O Mount Seir, and so will all of Edom. Then they will know that I am the LORD.[’’]

units.leftText: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear the LORD’s word.
units.rightText: “And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say: O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.

units.leftText: The Lord GOD says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because the enemy has said of you, ‘Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession,’

units.leftText: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;”
units.rightText: therefore prophesy and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Because they have made you desolate and have trampled you on every side, so that you became a possession of the rest of the nations and were taken up in slander by the lips of their talkers,

units.leftText: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD: The Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;
units.rightText: therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: therefore the Lord GOD says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Surely in My burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, who took My land as their own possession with wholehearted joy and utter contempt, so that its pastureland became plunder.

units.leftText: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”
units.rightText: Therefore, prophesy concerning the land of Israel and tell the mountains and hills, the ravines and valleys, that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I have spoken in My burning zeal because you have endured the reproach of the nations.

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I have sworn with an uplifted hand that surely the nations around you will endure reproach of their own.

units.leftText: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.
units.rightText: But you, O mountains of Israel, will produce branches and bear fruit for My people Israel, for they will soon come home.

units.leftText: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.
units.rightText: For behold, I am on your side; I will turn toward you, and you will be tilled and sown.

units.leftText: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.
units.rightText: I will multiply the people upon you — the house of Israel in its entirety. The cities will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.

units.leftText: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: I will fill you with people and animals, and they will multiply and be fruitful. I will make you as inhabited as you once were, and I will make you prosper more than before. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

units.leftText: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”
units.rightText: Yes, I will cause My people Israel to walk upon you; they will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will no longer deprive them of their children.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’
units.rightText: For this is what the Lord GOD says: Because people say to you, ‘You devour men and deprive your nation of its children,’

units.leftText: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: therefore you will no longer devour men or deprive your nation of its children, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord GOD.’”
units.rightText: I will no longer allow the taunts of the nations to be heard against you, and you will no longer endure the reproach of the peoples or cause your nation to stumble, declares the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
units.rightText: “Son of man, when the people of Israel lived in their land, they defiled it by their own ways and deeds. Their behavior before Me was like the uncleanness of a woman’s impurity.

units.leftText: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.
units.rightText: So I poured out My wrath upon them because of the blood they had shed on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.

units.leftText: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.
units.rightText: I dispersed them among the nations, and they were scattered throughout the lands. I judged them according to their ways and deeds.

units.leftText: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are the LORD’s people, and have left his land.’
units.rightText: And wherever they went among the nations, they profaned My holy name, because it was said of them, ‘These are the people of the LORD, yet they had to leave His land.’

units.leftText: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.
units.rightText: But I had concern for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations to which they had gone.

units.leftText: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord GOD says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.
units.rightText: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: It is not for your sake that I will act, O house of Israel, but for My holy name, which you profaned among the nations to which you went.

units.leftText: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD,” says the Lord GOD, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.
units.rightText: I will show the holiness of My great name, which has been profaned among the nations— the name you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, declares the Lord GOD, when I show My holiness in you before their eyes.

units.leftText: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.
units.rightText: For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and I will bring you back into your own land.

units.leftText: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.
units.rightText: I will also sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your impurities and all your idols.

units.leftText: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
units.rightText: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.

units.leftText: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.
units.rightText: And I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes and to carefully observe My ordinances.

units.leftText: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
units.rightText: Then you will live in the land that I gave your forefathers; you will be My people, and I will be your God.

units.leftText: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.
units.rightText: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will summon the grain and make it plentiful, and I will not bring famine upon you.

units.leftText: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.
units.rightText: I will also make the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field plentiful, so that you will no longer bear reproach among the nations on account of famine.

units.leftText: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
units.rightText: Then you will remember your evil ways and wicked deeds, and you will loathe yourselves for your iniquities and abominations.

units.leftText: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord GOD. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”
units.rightText: It is not for your sake that I will act, declares the Lord GOD — let it be known to you. Be ashamed and disgraced for your ways, O house of Israel!

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be resettled and the ruins to be rebuilt.

units.leftText: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.
units.rightText: The desolate land will be cultivated instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass through.

units.leftText: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’
units.rightText: Then they will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The cities that were once ruined, desolate, and destroyed are now fortified and inhabited.’

units.leftText: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, the LORD, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken it, and I will do it.”
units.rightText: Then the nations around you that remain will know that I, the LORD, have rebuilt what was destroyed, and I have replanted what was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: Once again I will hear the plea of the house of Israel and do for them this: I will multiply their people like a flock.

units.leftText: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
units.rightText: Like the numerous flocks for sacrifices at Jerusalem during her appointed feasts, so the ruined cities will be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”

units.leftText: The LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in the LORD’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
units.rightText: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and He brought me out by His Spirit and set me down in the middle of the valley, and it was full of bones.

units.leftText: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.
units.rightText: He led me all around among them, and I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley, and indeed, they were very dry.

units.leftText: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?”
units.rightText: Then He asked me, “Son of man, can these bones come to life?”

units.leftText: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear the LORD’s word.
units.rightText: And He said to me, “Prophesy concerning these bones and tell them, ‘Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!

units.leftText: The Lord GOD says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says to these bones: I will cause breath to enter you, and you will come to life.
rightNotes: 37:5 Or spirit; also in verses 6, 9, and 10

units.leftText: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”
units.rightText: I will attach tendons to you and make flesh grow upon you and cover you with skin. I will put breath within you so that you will come to life. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”

units.leftText: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.
units.rightText: So I prophesied as I had been commanded. And as I prophesied, there was suddenly a noise, a rattling, and the bones came together, bone to bone.

units.leftText: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
units.rightText: As I looked on, tendons appeared on them, flesh grew, and skin covered them; but there was no breath in them.

units.leftText: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”
units.rightText: Then He said to me, “Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and tell the breath that this is what the Lord GOD says: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe into these slain, so that they may live!”

units.leftText: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.
units.rightText: So I prophesied as He had commanded me, and the breath entered them, and they came to life and stood on their feet — a vast army.

units.leftText: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’
units.rightText: Then He said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Look, they are saying, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope has perished; we are cut off.’

units.leftText: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.
units.rightText: Therefore prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘O My people, I will open your graves and bring you up from them, and I will bring you back to the land of Israel.

units.leftText: You will know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.
units.rightText: Then you, My people, will know that I am the LORD, when I open your graves and bring you up from them.

units.leftText: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it and performed it,” says the LORD.’”
units.rightText: I will put My Spirit in you and you will live, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it, declares the LORD.’”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came again to me, saying,
units.rightText: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “You, son of man, take one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’
units.rightText: “And you, son of man, take a single stick and write on it: ‘Belonging to Judah and to the Israelites associated with him.’ Then take another stick and write on it: ‘Belonging to Joseph— the stick of Ephraim— and to all the house of Israel associated with him.’
rightNotes: 37:16 Or branch; also in verses 17, 19, and 20

units.leftText: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.
units.rightText: Then join them together into one stick, so that they become one in your hand.

units.leftText: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’
units.rightText: When your people ask you, ‘Won’t you explain to us what you mean by these?’

units.leftText: tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.
units.rightText: you are to tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel associated with him, and I will put them together with the stick of Judah. I will make them into a single stick, and they will become one in My hand.’

units.leftText: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’
units.rightText: When the sticks on which you write are in your hand and in full view of the people,

units.leftText: Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.
units.rightText: you are to tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will take the Israelites out of the nations to which they have gone, and I will gather them from all around and bring them into their own land.

units.leftText: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.
units.rightText: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel, and one king will rule over all of them. Then they will no longer be two nations and will never again be divided into two kingdoms.

units.leftText: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.
units.rightText: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols or detestable images, or with any of their transgressions. I will save them from all their apostasies by which they sinned, and I will cleanse them. Then they will be My people, and I will be their God.
rightNotes: 37:23 Many Hebrew manuscripts (see also LXX); most Hebrew manuscripts all their dwelling places where they sinned

units.leftText: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.
units.rightText: My servant David will be king over them, and there will be one shepherd for all of them. They will follow My ordinances and keep and observe My statutes.

units.leftText: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.
units.rightText: They will live in the land that I gave to My servant Jacob, where your fathers lived. They will live there forever with their children and grandchildren, and My servant David will be their prince forever.

units.leftText: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.
units.rightText: And I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and multiply them, and I will set My sanctuary among them forever.

units.leftText: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
units.rightText: My dwelling place will be with them; I will be their God, and they will be My people.
rightNotes: 37:27 Or My tabernacle
37:27 Cited in 2 Corinthians 6:16|2CO 6:16*

units.leftText: The nations will know that I am the LORD who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”
units.rightText: Then the nations will know that I the LORD sanctify Israel, when My sanctuary is among them forever.’”

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
units.rightText: “Son of man, set your face against Gog of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. Prophesy against him
rightNotes: 38:2 Or of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal

units.leftText: and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
units.rightText: and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
rightNotes: 38:3 Or Gog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal

units.leftText: I will turn you around, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, with all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords;
units.rightText: I will turn you around, put hooks in your jaws, and bring you out with all your army — your horses, your horsemen in full armor, and a great company armed with shields and bucklers, all brandishing their swords.

units.leftText: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;
units.rightText: Persia, Cush, and Put will accompany them, all with shields and helmets,
rightNotes: 38:5 That is, the upper Nile region

units.leftText: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you.
units.rightText: as well as Gomer with all its troops, and Beth-togarmah from the far north with all its troops— the many nations with you.

units.leftText: “‘“Be prepared, yes, prepare yourself, you, and all your companies who are assembled to you, and be a guard to them.
units.rightText: Get ready; prepare yourself, you and all your company gathered around you; you will be their guard.

units.leftText: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you will come into the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought out of the peoples and they will dwell securely, all of them.
units.rightText: After a long time you will be summoned. In the latter years you will enter a land that has recovered from war, whose people were gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate. They had been brought out from the nations, and all now dwell securely.

units.leftText: You will ascend. You will come like a storm. You will be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.”
units.rightText: You and all your troops, and many peoples with you will go up, advancing like a thunderstorm; you will be like a cloud covering the land.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “It will happen in that day that things will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: On that day, thoughts will arise in your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.

units.leftText: You will say, ‘I will go up to the land of unwalled villages. I will go to those who are at rest, who dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,
units.rightText: You will say, ‘I will go up against a land of unwalled villages; I will come against a quiet people who dwell securely, all of them living without walls or bars or gates—

units.leftText: to take the plunder and to take prey; to turn your hand against the waste places that are inhabited, and against the people who are gathered out of the nations, who have gotten livestock and goods, who dwell in the middle of the earth.’
units.rightText: in order to seize the spoil and carry off the plunder, to turn a hand against the desolate places now inhabited and against a people gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and possessions and who live at the center of the land.’

units.leftText: Sheba, Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, will ask you, ‘Have you come to take the plunder? Have you assembled your company to take the prey, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to take great plunder?’”’
units.rightText: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish with all its villages will ask, ‘Have you come to capture the plunder? Have you assembled your hordes to carry away loot, to make off with silver and gold, to take cattle and goods, to seize great spoil?’
rightNotes: 38:13 Or young lions

units.leftText: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and tell Gog, ‘The Lord GOD says: “In that day when my people Israel dwells securely, will you not know it?
units.rightText: Therefore prophesy, son of man, and tell Gog that this is what the Lord GOD says: On that day when My people Israel are dwelling securely, will you not take notice of this?
rightNotes: 38:14 LXX will you not rouse yourself?

units.leftText: You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you, and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army.
units.rightText: And you will come from your place out of the far north— you and many peoples with you, all riding horses— a mighty horde, a huge army.

units.leftText: You will come up against my people Israel as a cloud to cover the land. It will happen in the latter days that I will bring you against my land, that the nations may know me when I am sanctified in you, Gog, before their eyes.”
units.rightText: You will advance against My people Israel like a cloud covering the land. It will happen in the latter days, O Gog, that I will bring you against My land, so that the nations may know Me when I show Myself holy in you before their eyes.

units.leftText: “‘The Lord GOD says: “Are you he of whom I spoke in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them?
units.rightText: This is what the Lord GOD says: Are you the one of whom I have spoken in former days through My servants, the prophets of Israel, who in those times prophesied for years that I would bring you against them?

units.leftText: It will happen in that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel,” says the Lord GOD, “that my wrath will come up into my nostrils.
units.rightText: Now on that day when Gog comes against the land of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, My wrath will flare up.

units.leftText: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath I have spoken. Surely in that day there will be a great shaking in the land of Israel,
units.rightText: In My zeal and fiery rage I proclaim that on that day there will be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

units.leftText: so that the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, all creeping things who creep on the earth, and all the men who are on the surface of the earth will shake at my presence. Then the mountains will be thrown down, the steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.
units.rightText: The fish of the sea, the birds of the air, the beasts of the field, every creature that crawls upon the ground, and all mankind on the face of the earth will tremble at My presence. The mountains will be thrown down, the cliffs will collapse, and every wall will fall to the ground.

units.leftText: I will call for a sword against him to all my mountains,” says the Lord GOD. “Every man’s sword will be against his brother.
units.rightText: And I will summon a sword against Gog on all My mountains, declares the Lord GOD, and every man’s sword will be against his brother.

units.leftText: I will enter into judgment with him with pestilence and with blood. I will rain on him, on his hordes, and on the many peoples who are with him, torrential rains with great hailstones, fire, and sulfur.
units.rightText: I will execute judgment upon him with plague and bloodshed. I will pour out torrents of rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many nations with him.

units.leftText: I will magnify myself and sanctify myself, and I will make myself known in the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”’
units.rightText: I will magnify and sanctify Myself, and I will reveal Myself in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.[’’]

units.leftText: “You, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
units.rightText: “As for you, O son of man, prophesy against Gog and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
rightNotes: 39:1 Or Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal

units.leftText: I will turn you around, will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring you onto the mountains of Israel.
units.rightText: I will turn you around, drive you along, bring you up from the far north, and send you against the mountains of Israel.

units.leftText: I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.
units.rightText: Then I will strike the bow from your left hand and dash down the arrows from your right hand.

units.leftText: You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort and to the animals of the field to be devoured.
units.rightText: On the mountains of Israel you will fall — you and all your troops and the nations with you. I will give you as food to every kind of ravenous bird and wild beast.

units.leftText: You will fall on the open field, for I have spoken it,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: You will fall in the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “I will send a fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the islands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
units.rightText: I will send fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the LORD.

units.leftText: “‘“I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I won’t allow my holy name to be profaned any more. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
units.rightText: So I will make My holy name known among My people Israel and will no longer allow it to be profaned. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.

units.leftText: Behold, it comes, and it will be done,” says the Lord GOD. “This is the day about which I have spoken.
units.rightText: Yes, it is coming, and it will surely happen, declares the Lord GOD. This is the day of which I have spoken.

units.leftText: “‘“Those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and will make fires of the weapons and burn them, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the war clubs and the spears, and they will make fires with them for seven years;
units.rightText: Then those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out, kindle fires, and burn up the weapons— the bucklers and shields, the bows and arrows, the clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them for fuel.

units.leftText: so that they will take no wood out of the field, and not cut down any out of the forests; for they will make fires with the weapons. They will plunder those who plundered them, and rob those who robbed them,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: They will not gather wood from the countryside or cut it from the forests, for they will use the weapons for fuel. They will loot those who looted them and plunder those who plundered them, declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “‘“It will happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it will stop those who pass through. They will bury Gog and all his multitude there, and they will call it ‘The valley of Hamon Gog’.
units.rightText: And on that day I will give Gog a burial place in Israel, the Valley of the Travelers, east of the Sea. It will block those who travel through, because Gog and all his hordes will be buried there. So it will be called the Valley of Hamon-gog.
rightNotes: 39:11 That is, the Dead Sea
39:11 Hamon-gog means multitude of Gog.

units.leftText: “‘“The house of Israel will be burying them for seven months, that they may cleanse the land.
units.rightText: For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.

units.leftText: Yes, all the people of the land will bury them; and they will become famous in the day that I will be glorified,” says the Lord GOD.
units.rightText: All the people of the land will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day I display My glory, declares the Lord GOD.
rightNotes: 39:13 Or and the day I display My glory will be a day of renown

units.leftText: “‘“They will set apart men of continual employment who will pass through the land. Those who pass through will go with those who bury those who remain on the surface of the land, to cleanse it. After the end of seven months they will search.
units.rightText: And men will be employed to continually pass through the land to cleanse it by burying the invaders who remain on the ground. At the end of the seven months they will begin their search.

units.leftText: Those who search through the land will pass through; and when anyone sees a man’s bone, then he will set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.
units.rightText: As they pass through the land, anyone who sees a human bone will set up a pillar next to it, until the gravediggers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.

units.leftText: Hamonah will also be the name of a city. Thus they will cleanse the land.”’
units.rightText: (Even the city will be named Hamonah. ) And so they will cleanse the land.
rightNotes: 39:16 Hamonah means multitude or horde.

units.leftText: “You, son of man, the Lord GOD says: ‘Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, “Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat meat and drink blood.
units.rightText: And as for you, son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: Call out to every kind of bird and to every beast of the field: ‘Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you, a great feast on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood.

units.leftText: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
units.rightText: You will eat the flesh of the mighty and drink the blood of the princes of the earth as though they were rams, lambs, goats, and bulls — all the fattened animals of Bashan.

units.leftText: You shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
units.rightText: At the sacrifice I am preparing, you will eat fat until you are gorged and drink blood until you are drunk.

units.leftText: You shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord GOD.’
units.rightText: And at My table you will eat your fill of horses and riders, of mighty men and warriors of every kind,’ declares the Lord GOD.

units.leftText: “I will set my glory among the nations. Then all the nations will see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.
units.rightText: I will display My glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the judgment that I execute and the hand that I lay upon them.

units.leftText: So the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God, from that day and forward.
units.rightText: From that day forward the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.

units.leftText: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.
units.rightText: And the nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile for their iniquity, because they were unfaithful to Me. So I hid My face from them and delivered them into the hands of their enemies, so that they all fell by the sword.

units.leftText: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them.
units.rightText: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and transgressions, and I hid My face from them.

units.leftText: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Now I will reverse the captivity of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel. I will be jealous for my holy name.
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Now I will restore Jacob from captivity and will have compassion on the whole house of Israel, and I will be jealous for My holy name.
rightNotes: 39:25 Or restore the fortunes of Jacob

units.leftText: They will forget their shame and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwell securely in their land. No one will make them afraid
units.rightText: They will forget their disgrace and all the treachery they committed against Me, when they dwell securely in their land, with no one to frighten them.
rightNotes: 39:26 A few Hebrew manuscripts; MT They will bear

units.leftText: when I have brought them back from the peoples, gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations.
units.rightText: When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them out of the lands of their enemies, I will show My holiness in them in the sight of many nations.

units.leftText: They will know that I am the LORD their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land. Then I will leave none of them captive any more.
units.rightText: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, when I regather them to their own land, not leaving any of them behind after their exile among the nations.

units.leftText: I won’t hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord GOD.”
units.rightText: And I will no longer hide My face from them, for I will pour out My Spirit on the house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD.”

units.leftText: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck, in the same day, the LORD’s hand was on me, and he brought me there.
units.rightText: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month — in the fourteenth year after Jerusalem had been struck down — on that very day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He took me there.

units.leftText: In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was something like the frame of a city to the south.
units.rightText: In visions of God He took me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, on whose southern slope was a structure that resembled a city.

units.leftText: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
units.rightText: So He took me there, and I saw a man whose appearance was like bronze. He was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand.

units.leftText: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”
units.rightText: “Son of man,” he said to me, “look with your eyes, hear with your ears, and pay attention to everything I am going to show you, for that is why you have been brought here. Report to the house of Israel everything you see.”

units.leftText: Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
units.rightText: And I saw a wall surrounding the temple area. Now the length of the measuring rod in the man’s hand was six long cubits (each measuring a cubit and a handbreadth), and he measured the wall to be one rod thick and one rod high.
leftNotes: 40:5 A normal cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. A handbreadth is about 4.3 inches or 11 centimeters, so the long cubit described here would be about 22.3 inches or 57 centimeters long. Thus, a 6 long cubit measuring reed would have been about 3 yards 26.6 inches or about 3.42 meters long.
rightNotes: 40:5 6 long cubits, the length of the reed used for measuring, is approximately 10.5 feet or 3.2 meters; similarly in verses 6, 7, and 12. The long cubit of about 21 inches or 53.3 centimeters is the basic unit of length throughout Ezekiel 40 to 48.

units.leftText: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.
units.rightText: Then he came to the gate facing east and climbed its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate to be one rod deep.
rightNotes: 40:6 Hebrew one reed deep, even one threshold, one reed deep.

units.leftText: Every lodge was one reed long and one reed wide. Between the lodges was five cubits. The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.
units.rightText: Each gate chamber was one rod long and one rod wide, and there were five cubits between the gate chambers. The inner threshold of the gate by the portico facing inward was one rod deep.
rightNotes: 40:7 5 (long) cubits is approximately 8.75 feet or 2.7 meters; also in verses 30 and 48.

units.leftText: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.
units.rightText: Then he measured the portico of the gateway inside;
rightNotes: 40:8 Literally the portico of the gateway inside, one rod

units.leftText: Then he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.
units.rightText: it was eight cubits deep, and its jambs were two cubits thick. And the portico of the gateway faced the temple.
rightNotes: 40:9 8 (long) cubits is approximately 14 feet or 4.3 meters.
40:9 2 (long) cubits is approximately 3.5 feet or 1.1 meters.

units.leftText: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side. The three of them were of one measure. The posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
units.rightText: There were three gate chambers on each side of the east gate, each with the same measurements, and the gateposts on either side also had the same measurements.

units.leftText: He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;
units.rightText: And he measured the width of the gateway entrance to be ten cubits, and its length was thirteen cubits.
rightNotes: 40:11 10 (long) cubits is approximately 17.5 feet or 5.3 meters.
40:11 13 (long) cubits is approximately 22.75 feet or 6.9 meters.

units.leftText: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
units.rightText: In front of each gate chamber was a wall one cubit high, and the gate chambers were six cubits square.

units.leftText: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door.
units.rightText: Then he measured the gateway from the roof of one gate chamber to the roof of the opposite one; the distance was twenty-five cubits from doorway to doorway.
rightNotes: 40:13 25 (long) cubits is approximately 43.75 feet or 13.3 meters; also in verses 21, 25, 29, 30, 33, and 36.

units.leftText: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.
units.rightText: Next he measured the gateposts to be sixty cubits high. The gateway extended around to the gatepost of the courtyard.
rightNotes: 40:14 60 (long) cubits is approximately 105 feet or 32 meters.

units.leftText: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.
units.rightText: And the distance from the entrance of the gateway to the far end of its inner portico was fifty cubits.
rightNotes: 40:15 50 (long) cubits is approximately 87.5 feet or 26.7 meters; also in verses 21, 25, 29, 33, and 36.

units.leftText: There were closed windows to the side rooms, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches. Windows were around inward. Palm trees were on each post.
units.rightText: The gate chambers and their side pillars had beveled windows all around the inside of the gateway. The porticos also had windows all around on the inside. Each side pillar was decorated with palm trees.
rightNotes: 40:16 Or gateposts or jambs or projecting walls; here and throughout Ezekiel 40 and 41.

units.leftText: Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms were on the pavement.
units.rightText: Then he brought me into the outer court, and there were chambers and a pavement laid out all around the court. Thirty chambers faced the pavement,

units.leftText: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.
units.rightText: which flanked the gateways and corresponded to the length of the gates; this was the lower pavement.

units.leftText: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.
units.rightText: Then he measured the distance from the front of the lower gateway to the outside of the inner court; it was a hundred cubits on the east side as well as on the north.
rightNotes: 40:19 100 (long) cubits is approximately 175 feet or 53.3 meters; also in verses 23, 27, and 47.

units.leftText: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.
units.rightText: He also measured the length and width of the gateway of the outer court facing north.

units.leftText: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side. Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
units.rightText: Its three gate chambers on each side, its side pillars, and its portico all had the same measurements as the first gate: fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

units.leftText: Its windows, its arches, and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east. They went up to it by seven steps. Its arches were before them.
units.rightText: Its windows, portico, and palm trees had the same measurements as those of the gate facing east. Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them.

units.leftText: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.
units.rightText: There was a gate to the inner court facing the north gate, just as there was on the east. He measured the distance from gateway to gateway to be a hundred cubits.

units.leftText: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.
units.rightText: Then he led me to the south side, and I saw a gateway facing south. He measured its side pillars and portico, and they had the same measurements as the others.

units.leftText: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like the other windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
units.rightText: Both the gateway and its portico had windows all around, like the other windows. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

units.leftText: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them. It had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.
units.rightText: Seven steps led up to it, and its portico was opposite them; it had palm trees on its side pillars, one on each side.

units.leftText: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.
units.rightText: The inner court also had a gate facing south, and he measured the distance from gateway to gateway toward the south to be a hundred cubits.

units.leftText: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;
units.rightText: Next he brought me into the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it had the same measurements as the others.

units.leftText: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.
units.rightText: Its gate chambers, side pillars, and portico had the same measurements as the others. Both the gateway and its portico had windows all around; it was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

units.leftText: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.
units.rightText: (The porticoes around the inner court were twenty-five cubits long and five cubits deep. )
rightNotes: 40:30 The porticoes were approximately 43.75 feet long and 8.75 feet deep (13.3 meters long and 2.7 meters deep).

units.leftText: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps.
units.rightText: Its portico faced the outer court, and its side pillars were decorated with palm trees. Eight steps led up to it.

units.leftText: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;
units.rightText: And he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gateway; it had the same measurements as the others.

units.leftText: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.
units.rightText: Its gate chambers, side pillars, and portico had the same measurements as the others. Both the gateway and its portico had windows all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

units.leftText: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.
units.rightText: Its portico faced the outer court, and its side pillars were decorated with palm trees on each side. Eight steps led up to it.

units.leftText: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements—
units.rightText: Then he brought me to the north gate and measured it. It had the same measurements as the others,

units.leftText: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits.
units.rightText: as did its gate chambers, side pillars, and portico. It also had windows all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

units.leftText: Its posts were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.
units.rightText: Its portico faced the outer court, and its side pillars were decorated with palm trees on each side. Eight steps led up to it.
rightNotes: 40:37 LXX and Vulgate (see also verses 26, 31, and 34); Hebrew jambs or dividing wall

units.leftText: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates. They washed the burnt offering there.
units.rightText: There was a chamber with a doorway by the portico in each of the inner gateways. There the burnt offering was to be washed.
rightNotes: 40:38 Hebrew at the jambs
